name: Guild Herald
desc: Wealthy guilds draw the attention of soldiers willing to carry their standards into battle.

name: Giraffe Calf
desc: The barbaric centaur over-hunted giraffes for decades, but it was the tauren who saved this species from extinction.

name: Tiny Twister
desc: Twisters delight in sneaking up on unsuspecting creatures and surprising them with gusts up their nostrils.

name: Lunar Lantern
desc: These magical lanterns are acquired at the Lunar Festival, which celebrates the defeat of the Burning Legion by the free races of Azeroth.

name: Rascal-Bot
desc: This little guy seems to like to hang out at the fringes of cataclysmic events. There is no evidence to suggest he has anything to do with the cause of these events, though - he's probably just an observer. Or maybe he just gets lost on his trek to other places.

name: Crimson Snake
desc: The crimson snake is favored among the Darkspear trolls for not only its vicious nature, but also its steadfast loyalty.

name: Clockwork Rocket Bot
desc: This mechanical warrior is a favorite gift during Winter Veil. Batteries not included, but rockets definitely are!

name: Crimson Geode
desc: Therazane wore these spunky crimson elementals as jewelry before the azure craze swept through Deepholm.

name: Gilnean Raven
desc: Quoth the raven: the last word you said. It gets old.

name: Hare
desc: A carrot, a box, a stick, and some string. Wait a few hours and you'll have a hare.

name: Spiky Lizard
desc: The coloration of the spiky lizard allows it to blend in seamlessly with the desert sands of Silithus.

name: Shimmershell Snail
desc: Hunts for food just below the water's surface on the coast of Darkshore.

name: Sunfur Panda
desc: These cuddly rascals enjoy basking in the sun, sleeping in the sun, and napping in the sun.

name: Snowy Panda
desc: The white fur of the Snowy Panda allows it to hide in the snowbanks of Kun-Lai Summit.

name: Mountain Panda
desc: Cousin to the Snowy Panda, Mountain Pandas reside in the lower regions of Kun-Lai Summit.

name: Red Dragonhawk Hatchling
desc: Mortal enemies with silver dragonhawks; on pretty good terms with golden dragonhawks.

name: Silver Dragonhawk Hatchling
desc: Ferocious species of dragonhawk, often seen diving down on prey from high in the sky.

name: Orange Tabby Cat
desc: The last person who tried to housebreak this cat quickly learned that a soiled rug is better than a shredded everything-else.

name: Poley
desc: This cub shares many traits with its relatives, but it's in a league of its own with its singing ability.

name: Father Winter's Helper
desc: These off-season allies work tirelessly to prepare for the Feast of Winter Veil, and would appreciate not being disturbed the rest of the year.

name: Dragon Kite
desc: Much quieter than a real dragon.

name: Mouse
desc: It seems that mice are completely incapable of resisting cheese even in the face of imprisonment, injury, or death.

name: Squirrel
desc: Most people do not know the difference between a squirrel and a chipmunk. Most don't care.

name: Sootpaw
desc: This magical scout can often be found rummaging for arcane treats  in the refuse of long-past adventurers.

name: Frosticus Maximus
desc: Trying to live up to her ancestry, this little one is ready to rampage. She is going to start with small spiders and work up from there.

name: Long-Tailed Mole
desc: Thought by many to be nothing more than the subject of children's nursery rhymes, the long-tailed mole is very much real.

name: Creepy Crawly
desc: These beetles often make their homes in quarries abandoned by the Horde war machine in Durotar.

name: Gazelle Fawn
desc: Young gazelles quickly learn to flee when they hear the war cries of tauren hunters in Mulgore.  They don't hear the good hunters, unfortunately.

name: Willy
desc: He's slightly evil but extremely narcoleptic. Keep him away from critters!

name: Jade Crane Chick
desc: A graceful creature from the isle of Pandaria.

name: Shy Bandicoon
desc: A goblin alchemist once claimed that the bite of this raccoon gave him the gift of prophecy. Turns out, it was just rabies.

name: Sinister Squashling
desc: This mischievous gourd likes to pop out of the ground and scare you right out of your pants. Hail to the pumpkin song!

name: Robo-Chick
desc: Originally built by an irate goblin to annoy neighbors with an early morning wake-up call.

name: Mechanical Chicken
desc: Not to worry; the combat mechanisms and homing logic have been disabled on this unit, I think. --Oglethorpe Obnoticus

name: Toxic Wasteling
desc: This, um, 'adorable' little guy likes to play with critters. Just don't let them get too close.

name: Ruby Sapling
desc: Small elemental saplings grow into treants, fierce defenders of forests and groves.

name: Crimson Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell in humid, tropical areas and feed on Kingsblood nectar.

name: Micronax
desc: Whenever his forces would experience setbacks in Azeroth, Kil'jaeden would pull out Micronax and terrorize the local cat-like creatures of Argus to vent his frustrations.

name: Mechanopeep
desc: Used as a training mount for young gnomes, the Mechanopeep has none of the speed but all of the charm of its bigger brothers.

name: Grunty
desc: Only the rarest of murlocs is able to successfully cross dimensional barriers. Fewer still return with the kind of advanced armor and weaponry possessed by Grunty.

name: Razzashi Hatchling
desc: Razzashi raptors are among the cleverest predators in the jungle, making them favored by the Gurubashi trolls.

name: Ravager Hatchling
desc: These voracious carnivores first arrived on Azeroth aboard the draenei's dimensional fortress, the Exodar.

name: Malayan Quillrat
desc: Many believe that the quillrat is able to shoot its spines at aggressors.

name: Sand Kitten
desc: Originally bred by the Sandfury trolls as pets, these feral and savage felines prowl the deserts of Tanaris.

name: Spawn of Onyxia
desc: These vicious fire-breathing whelps escaped Onyxia's lair and fled into the surrounding region. Handle with extreme caution.

name: Little Fawn
desc: She likes the company of friends. Seventy-five of them, to be precise.

name: Jade Oozeling
desc: Jade Oozelings glow in the dark, making them a welcome sight to workers in pitch-black mineshafts.

name: Sandy Petrel
desc: The sandy petrel flies high above the Windless Isle, safe from landbound predators.

name: Speedy
desc: Slow and steady wins the race.

name: Red Moth
desc: A product of exposure to wild magical energies, this insect is the unexpectedly colorful result of Azerothian moth species being released into the eco-domes of the Netherstorm.

name: Forest Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell in cool, forested areas and feed on Mageroyal nectar.

name: Sifang Otter
desc: The sifang otter lives near rivers and is normally friendly and playful.

name: Amethyst Spiderling
desc: A rarity among arachnids, these non-venomous critters feed solely on plants and fruit.

name: Curious Wolvar Pup
desc: Despite their smaller stature, the wolvar are some of the most aggressive creatures in Northrend. This often makes their curious nature intimidating.

name: De-Weaponized Mechanical Companion
desc: The gold standard for sturdy gnomish design, this mechanical critter is the perfect companion for the lonely engineer on the go.

name: Ghostly Skull
desc: When it senses the impending death of a nearby creature, the skull will emit an ear-piercing cackle.

name: Dark Whelpling
desc: Hopes that someday it can grow up to destroy villages, just like mommy.

name: Masked Tanuki Pup
desc: Many young raccoons rail against their strict curfews, complaining that dawn is way too early to go to bed.

name: Giant Sewer Rat
desc: You wouldn't want to meet this rat in a dark alley. Or anywhere else, for that matter.

name: Stone Armadillo
desc: When these sleepy critters aren't snoozing, they use their massive claws to dig for tasty insect snacks.

name: Ash Viper
desc: This ill-tempered snake species makes its home around the fiery molten pits of the Burning Steppes.

name: Festering Maggot
desc: It can swallow three times its own body weight in blood.

name: Cheetah Cub
desc: These playful feline cubs practice their hunting skills by stalking each other through the Barrens.

name: Cenarion Hatchling
desc: Not yet the fearsome creatures they grow to in adulthood, the Cenarion hatchlings have an almost harmless appearance that has caught novice trainers of the Cenarion Circle off guard.

name: Scalded Basilisk Hatchling
desc: This grumpy species of basilisk roams the Blade's Edge Mountains, avoiding contact with other critters whenever possible.

name: Whiskers the Rat
desc: A clever tactician, Whiskers will feign death to fool predators and bill collectors.

name: Tranquil Mechanical Yeti
desc: This clever toy is equipped with a secret switch to disable its 'tranquil' mode. Luckily, even the engineers who built it don't know how to find it.

name: Armadillo Pup
desc: Rolls into a protective ball when it feels threatened. Or when its mother calls.

name: Infected Squirrel
desc: More horrifying than its appearance is that the infected squirrels of the Plaguelands no longer hoard nuts, instead collecting rotten, decaying flesh.

name: Kirin Tor Familiar
desc: To prevent apprentices from secretly using the familiar to complete their chores, the archmagi placed the ritual required to summon the creature across the pages of several spellbooks hidden throughout Dalaran.

name: Zergling
desc: A small, fierce member of the Zerg swarm, the zergling is not to be trifled with. Very dangerous in high numbers.

name: Gryphon Hatchling
desc: A gift from the Wildhammer dwarves to the heroes of the Alliance, these hatchlings are descendants of the same gryphons ridden by Falstad and his entourage into Grim Batol.

name: Creepy Crate
desc: Previous owners of the crate have reported the disappearance of other pets from their collection.

name: Winterspring Cub
desc: Winterspring cubs are happiest when frolicking in freshly fallen snow.

name: Legs
desc: Wild marsh walkers are dangerously aggressive, but they're loyal and affectionate if you manage to tame them.

name: Emerald Boa
desc: Hunted for its beautifully patterned skin, this majestic species thrives alongside Azeroth's lush rivers.

name: Arctic Hare
desc: The heart of an arctic hare beats twice as fast as a common hare.

name: Dun Morogh Cub
desc: The bears of Dun Morogh are prized for their hardiness, loyalty, and combat prowess. Their time among the dwarves does little to curb their ferocity.

name: Pet Bombling
desc: Possibly explosive, definitely adorable. Keep away from open flame.

name: Alpine Chipmunk
desc: Many an explorer has been entranced by the adorable nature of the alpine chipmunk, failing to notice its small teeth on frostbitten digits.

name: Fledgling Buzzard
desc: Always wear a helm in the Redridge Mountains. Buzzards view humanoid hair as excellent nesting material.

name: Scorpid
desc: Venom capable of killing creatures up to 100 times its own body weight.

name: Thundertail Flapper
desc: Touched by lightning, these dangerous rodents should be kept at a safe distance.

name: Red Panda
desc: Can you believe how cute I am?  Me neither.

name: Great Horned Owl
desc: Night elf children are given an owl feather on their first birthday as a token of good luck.

name: Snowy Owl
desc: Winterspring's furbolg prize the brilliant white feathers of these majestic creatures for ritual purposes.

name: Curious Oracle Hatchling
desc: The bouncy gurloc is a distant cousin of the murloc.

name: Blue Mini Jouster
desc: Unlike its gold counterpart, the blue mini jouster takes a leisurely pace when jabbing its opponent's eyeballs.

name: Personal World Destroyer
desc: Goblin engineering at its finest. Blueprints based on the massive fel reaver in Hellfire Peninsula.

name: Moonkin Hatchling
desc: Moonkin are blessed by Elune and spread nature's grace wherever they travel. The festive fowls are always in the mood for a dance.

name: Crawling Claw
desc: This appears to be nothing more than the paw of a small primate. A closer inspection shows that the hand has been dried by centuries of exposure to the sands of Uldum.

name: Gold Mini Jouster
desc: This critter is infamous for its ability to unleash a fast and furious eyeball jabbing.

name: Small Frog
desc: This is a small frog.

name: Grotto Vole
desc: Grotto voles are often confused with mice. Never twice.

name: Tiny Flamefly
desc: After swarming around open lava pits during the day, these strange insects emit a fiery glow at night.

name: Deathy
desc: Deathwing's emergence transformed the whole of Azeroth; not even the ocean-dwelling murlocs were immune to his corrupt influence.

name: Gregarious Grell
desc: The grell are embodiments of the wild side of nature. Tame ones are very rare.

name: Moonkin Hatchling
desc: The distinct roar of the moonkin is one of the most terrifying sounds in nature.

name: Sea Pony
desc: Despite its diminutive size, it is impossible to miss a sea pony cutting through the water.

name: Rat Snake
desc: Years ago, humans introduced these reptiles into Duskwood to cull the local rat population.

name: Miniwing
desc: The magical energies released during Skywing's transformation back into his true arakkoa form liberated this poor creature, a fledgling bird imprisoned by Luanga in order to power his fowl curse.

name: Crimson Lasher
desc: Native to the ashen soils of the Firelands, the lasher was transplanted to Azeroth with the help of the Guardians of Hyjal.

name: Highlands Mouse
desc: The mice of the highlands, perhaps twisted by the Twilight's Hammer, are aggressive and fight for dominance between each other.

name: Winter Reindeer
desc: Would rather not spend any more time inside a wrapped holiday gift box.

name: Turkey
desc: A key food source during the Feast of Winter Veil.

name: Sifang Otter Pup
desc: Otters swim by propelling themselves with their powerful tails and flexing their long bodies. Very fast in the water.

name: Tainted Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell in corrupted woodlands and feed on Purple Lotus nectar.

name: Molten Hatchling
desc: These blisteringly hot spiders camouflage themselves by blending in with oozing magma.

name: Snow Cub
desc: The thick snow near Dun Morogh acts as camouflage for snow cubs learning to hunt.

name: Porcupette
desc: Despite the name you should absolutely never, ever pet it.

name: Silkbead Snail
desc: Hides in shell to escape claws of nearby crabs.

name: Rattlesnake
desc: Wildhammer dwarves train young gryphons by sending them out to hunt rattlesnakes in the Twilight Highlands.

name: Murkablo
desc: When you're confronting Murkablo or any of the Prime Murlocs, possession of a soulstone is strongly advised.

name: Lizard Hatchling
desc: If a female lizard does not lay her clutch in a well camouflaged area, her eggs will likely be devoured by Lashtail Raptors.

name: Mountain Skunk
desc: The mountain skunk is most famous for its adventurous nature. No really, that is what it is famous for.

name: Lucky Quilen Cub
desc: Offspring of the Imperial Quilen.

name: Shore Crab
desc: These arthropods line many Azerothian shores and seek to fulfill their one true desire: to pinch.

name: Cockroach
desc: They were here long before us and will be here long after we are gone.

name: Forest Spiderling
desc: This vicious species weaves elaborate webs throughout the dense jungles of Stranglethorn Vale.

name: Oasis Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell along desert streams, wells or watering holes and feed on Whiptail nectar.

name: Lava Crab
desc: The thick exoskeleton of this adaptable arthropod allows it to thrive in harsh environments.

name: Wharf Rat
desc: Just like the rough and tumble sailors who live dockside, the wharf rats are feral, violent creatures.

name: King Snake
desc: This snake is often seen sunning on the exposed rocks high in the Badlands.

name: Cockatiel
desc: Some say this clever bird can be taught to speak--but it's smart enough to keep its beak shut.

name: Moccasin
desc: When hunting or evading predators, this snake can travel on the surface of water for short distances.

name: Emerald Whelpling
desc: Once bred and raised by the green dragon Itharius, this unique breed of dragon has settled in the jungles of Feralas.

name: Huge Toad
desc: This is a huge toad.

name: Lava Beetle
desc: Beetles in the Burning Steppes roll magma into tiny balls and eat them once they cool off.

name: Carrion Rat
desc: Where there is carrion, there will always be rats.

name: Crystal Spider
desc: These strange critters glimmer like ice, allowing them to hide among Winterspring's snowy expanses.

name: Grizzly Squirrel
desc: In the deep forest, even the small creatures must have the ferocity to fend for themselves.

name: Gold Beetle
desc: Tiny, autonomous machines created by the Titans to clean and maintain their mighty edifices.

name: Alpine Hare
desc: The alpine hare can burrow into the permafrost and hibernate for weeks or even months.

name: Silithid Hatchling
desc: These hatchlings entertain themselves by clacking their mandibles together in increasingly complex rhythms.

name: Spirebound Crab
desc: These tiny arthropods are Pandaria natives that call the area of the Windless Isle their home.

name: Mana Wyrmling
desc: The ethereal Rashaad began breeding these enigmatic creatures after learning of their ability to feed on arcane energies.

name: Spirit Crab
desc: The souls of slain crabs seek vengeance against the murlocs who ate them.

name: Rabid Nut Varmint 5000
desc: Considered by most to be a significant improvement to the 4000 series, there were nonetheless serious concerns about the amount of heat they produced.

name: Lost of Lordaeron
desc: These small spirits find their undead neighbors to be poor company, so they typically wander Tirisfal Glades alone.

name: Tol'vir Scarab
desc: Carrion feeders often found in large numbers within ancient unearthed tombs; they can survive long periods of time without feeding.

name: Nordrassil Wisp
desc: During the Third War, thousands of these mystical beings annihilated the demon lord Archimonde.

name: Tiny Sporebat
desc: Wild sporebats are vicious creatures, but if tamed at a young age, they can be loyal companions.

name: Brown Rabbit
desc: This bunny is the cutest thing its opponent will ever see. It'll also be the last.

name: Guild Page
desc: Guild pages must be fearless since they are called upon to announce their guild's victories over the Horde in battle.

name: Deepholm Cockroach
desc: The cockroaches of Deepholm can burrow into stone itself to make their nests.

name: Adder
desc: Unlike other snakes that actively hunt, these crafty reptiles hide in thick foliage and ambush their prey.

name: Sidewinder
desc: Native to Azeroth's desert regions, these resilient reptiles can survive for weeks without water.

name: Wildhammer Gryphon Hatchling
desc: Too afraid to attempt flying until thrown from a great height.

name: Plump Turkey
desc: He's humble, clairvoyant, and delicious with cranberry sauce.

name: Mechanical Squirrel
desc: A mechanical squirrel's logic center tells it to collect and store both nuts and bolts for the winter.

name: Mini Diablo
desc: AND THE HEAVENS SHALL TREMBLE, AND MAN SHALL WEEP, AND THE END OF DAYS SHALL--wait, why are you so tall?

name: Murky
desc: Appearances of this beloved and ultra-reclusive murloc are sure to draw a crowd.

name: Disgusting Oozeling
desc: Warning: Wear gloves and goggles while handling disgusting oozeling. DO NOT WASH. Will stain most armor.

name: Gurky
desc: Gurky is a born performer, though she remains elusive, making public appearances only on the rarest of occasions.

name: Frosty
desc: Accidentally created when the Lich King's deathly powers raised Rimefang from undeath.

name: Blue Dragonhawk Hatchling
desc: Raised by the few dealers still willing to trade in Netherstorm.

name: Prairie Mouse
desc: On the prairie there are numerous rodents and other small creatures, but none more common than the mouse.

name: Blighthawk
desc: Curiously, this hawk uses its razor-sharp talons to peel the bark off trees as it searches for bugs, even though it has no need for sustenance.

name: Frog
desc: For every frog, a prince and princess in waiting.

name: Tiny Snowman
desc: He loves to dance and wave and play with you! He melts after Winter Veil, but don't worry; he'll be back again someday!

name: Ravasaur Hatchling
desc: Larger than other raptor infants, these hatchlings grow into towering reptilian beasts capable of massive devastation.

name: Turquoise Turtle
desc: Turtles are feared by the naga, who consider them bad luck and give them a wide berth on the shores of Azshara.

name: Yakrat
desc: The bond between yak and rat is a strange one, and what the rat gains out of the symbiotic relationship is a mystery.

name: Clouded Hedgehog
desc: Hedgehogs are not at all fond of croquet nor flamingos.

name: Savory Beetle
desc: The most delicious of the beetle family.

name: Sun Darter Hatchling
desc: This unique species of faerie dragon is not usually found on Azeroth.

name: Maggot
desc: The preferred habitat of this creature is woodland areas where it can safely complete its metamorphosis.

name: Crunchy Scorpion
desc: Unique carapace is prized by trinket makers for its texture and strength.

name: Tiny Goldfish
desc: This bubble is way worse than a tank.

name: Golden Pig
desc: This golden pig honors its ancestors by giving its allies good fortune.

name: Unborn Val'kyr
desc: Val'kyr are considered "unborn" until they vanquish a creature of high nobility.

name: Netherwhelp
desc: Offspring of the nether drakes of Outland, this young dragon is still growing into its role as hunter, protector, and adorable terror of the skies.

name: Soul of the Aspects
desc: The Soul of the Aspects is said to be possessed of mercurial moods ranging from stoic and deliberate to unpredictable and erratic, to loving and deeply pensive.

name: Mr. Chilly
desc: Mr. Chilly's appearance evokes a more civilized era, when duelists battled in tuxedos.

name: Luyu Moth
desc: A daring, narcissist insect willing to brave any threat in its pursuit of the spotlight.

name: Pterrordax Hatchling
desc: Pterrordax eggs are incubated underneath the fossils of their forebears, allowing the hatchlings to absorb their ancestors' ferocity and intelligence.

name: Fungal Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell in dark caves and feed on Heartblossom nectar.

name: Tolai Hare Pup
desc: Tolai hare pups are sent from their dens at a young age to find their own way.

name: Cobra Hatchling
desc: The cobras of Azeroth are renowned for their fast-acting venom and swift strikes.

name: Argent Squire
desc: Many of Stormwind's youth joined the Argent Crusade as squires, hoping to one day serve the Holy Light in battle.

name: Phoenix Hatchling
desc: A child of phoenix god Al'ar, the hatchling takes flight immediately after birth.

name: White Tickbird Hatchling
desc: The rare albino tickbird is revered amongst the Oracles. It is seen as a sign of heavy rainstorms, good grub harvests, and hibernating wolvar.

name: Tuskarr Kite
desc: Seeing these kites soaring above Northrend's shores is a clear sign that tuskarr are nearby.

name: Mountain Cottontail
desc: Mountain cottontails can leap up a steep incline with speed you would not believe.

name: Core Hound Pup
desc: Found in the Firelands and the Molten Core, core hounds can trace their lineage back to the alpha male, Magmadar.

name: Essence of Competition
desc: Only heroes who have proven their valor through great acts are gifted one of these mystical serpentine creatures.

name: Death's Head Cockroach
desc: The markings on the carapace of this cockroach closely resemble that of the Death's Head.

name: Tiny Red Dragon
desc: Said to bring good fortune when spotted in autumn.  Known to hide from unfamiliar creatures.

name: Spectral Tiger Cub
desc: Affectionate and curious, these kittens seem to find the most peculiar hiding places.

name: Pebble
desc: An adventurous little elemental, Pebble escaped hungry gyreworms in the Crumbling Depths, braved the emptiness of the Twisting Nether, and ultimately found himself rescued from a mailbox.

name: Clockwork Gnome
desc: Thought to be an original construct of the titans, the clockwork gnome has some gears smaller than the eye can see.

name: Lil' K.T.
desc: In life, Kel'Thuzad betrayed the Kirin Tor and created the Cult of the Damned. In death, he serves the Scourge as the Archlich Lord of Naxxramas.

name: Fox Kit
desc: The fighting in Tol Barad has made it difficult to find these kits, and numerous would-be owners have decimated the fox population there as a result.

name: Onyx Panther
desc: The onyx panther is invisible at night, like a stalking shadow, and disappears with the dawn.

name: Darkmoon Tonk
desc: A favorite of children across Azeroth, this tough little toy can withstand even the most aggressive imagination.

name: Cat
desc: After centuries of domestication, these furry critters inhabit nearly every human nation in the Eastern Kingdoms.

name: Brown Prairie Dog
desc: A complex system of burrows protects the prairie dog from its neighbors' massive hooves.

name: Resilient Roach
desc: The roaches of the Dread Wastes dwell in the shadows. Some people swear the shadows travel with them.

name: Golden Civet
desc: Civets are landbound cousins of the otter and are prized for their heady musks.

name: Voodoo Figurine
desc: Voodoo figurines were often empowered by flasks of mojo, troll sweat, and the flesh of tribal enemies.

name: Lumpy
desc: A stowaway from Greatfather Winter's workshop, this tiny elemental found himself trapped in a present that was stolen by the Abominable Greench.

name: Tree Python
desc: Stranglethorn's Gurubashi trolls often capture these powerful beasts to keep as pets... or to cook as meals.

name: Nether Ray Fry
desc: Native to the Terokkar Forest, nether rays spawn during the rainy season. Out of the hundreds of offspring resulting from one hatching, very few survive to adulthood.

name: Emerald Turtle
desc: It is difficult to believe that Shen-zin Su, on whose shell rests all of the Wandering Isle, began life as a tiny emerald turtle.

name: Nether Roach
desc: The nether roach has adapted to the cold vacuum of space and requires no air to survive. Inside it bears almost no resemblance to a common roach.

name: Biletoad
desc: The rumors of the medicinal uses of the biletoad were believed to have been started by a particularly mischievous apothecary.

name: Muckbreath
desc: Muckbreath is just like other crocolisks, except he has an excellent sense of humor.

name: Golden Civet Kitten
desc: The civets are known to guard their young ferociously.

name: Yellow-Bellied Bullfrog
desc: Despite its menacing appearance, the yellow-bellied bullfrog was aptly named.

name: Tainted Cockroach
desc: Even cockroaches were not strong enough to withstand the foul seepage of demonic corruption.

name: Magical Crawdad
desc: Only magical wishes make magical crawdads. If you wish for a fish, fish for a wish.

name: Stowaway Rat
desc: In the lean times when adrift at sea, the sight of a rat was a welcome one.

name: Crimson Shale Hatchling
desc: Through experimentation, the mages of Dalaran have discovered that the powered remains of a crimson shale spider will greatly increase the conflagration of their fire spells.

name: Stormwind Rat
desc: Unnoticed but to cats and ratcatchers, when Deathwing descended upon Stormwind all the rats beat a hasty retreat from the city. Only of late have they returned.

name: Green Wing Macaw
desc: Favored pet of the Defias pirates, this colorful bird is handy for remembering passwords, grocery lists, and cracker recipes.

name: Pengu
desc: Notable for its wide eyes and sassy slide.

name: Bucktooth Flapper
desc: It's hard to know what's more dangerous: the teeth or the tail.

name: Snarly
desc: Crocolisks are six-legged amphibian predators found in coastal waters. Archaeologists believe they may be descended from the diemetradons of Un'Goro Crater.

name: Chuck
desc: After studying the crocolisk species for several years, the famed angler Nat Pagle determined that baby crocolisks are mostly harmless.

name: Fetish Shaman
desc: Fetish shaman are empowered by the spirits of their fallen ancestors. These malevolent spirits are bound to the shaman's tribal spear. Control this spear, and you control the shaman.

name: Grasslands Cottontail
desc: Despite their idyllic surroundings, grasslands cottontails hop at surprising speed when evading their pursuers.

name: Wind Rider Cub
desc: Thorg No-Legs never paid heed to the old orc saying, 'Don't pull a wyvern's tail.'

name: Purple Puffer
desc: You might think this fish out of water would be a weak opponent... until you see the intensity that lies within its protective bubble.

name: Black Lamb
desc: Offspring of the black sheep, the black lamb is only found in the forests of Elwynn.

name: Brown Marmot
desc: Distinct from their Azerothian relatives, these critters of Outland make their home in Blade's Edge Mountains.

name: Qiraji Guardling
desc: The squeaks used by these tiny insectoids may sound cute, but they're actually screaming for your death.

name: Spiny Lizard
desc: The children of Orgrimmar frequently capture these lizards as pets.  The adults of Orgrimmar frequently step on them.

name: Stripe-Tailed Scorpid
desc: Less venomous but more aggressive than other breeds of scorpion.

name: Onyxian Whelpling
desc: Spawn of Onyxia, this young dragon has decided that it doesn't want to follow in its grandfathers' cataclysmic footsteps.

name: Horde Balloon
desc: A magical wonder, these balloons will never deflate and are traditionally created in batches of ninety-nine.

name: Grey Moth
desc: You can easily locate moths if you wear expensive garments near Ammen Vale. They can't resist the delicious taste of high fashion.

name: Irradiated Roach
desc: Most creatures cannot withstand a fraction of the harsh conditions that roaches can thrive in.

name: Rock Viper
desc: Long ago, Mount Hyjal's druids tempered this species to live in peace alongside the region's other creatures.

name: Skittering Cavern Crawler
desc: These arachnids use their razor-sharp legs to carve tunnels in the solid rock of the Blade's Edge Mountains.

name: Gundrak Hatchling
desc: This crafty raptor was born in the icy wastes of Northrend. Its harsh upbringing gives it strength when many others would perish.

name: Effervescent Glowfly
desc: Luminescent body used to attract mates.

name: Flayer Youngling
desc: A brash fel orc once tried to enslave these critters as his personal soldiers. Pieces of him are still scattered across Outland.

name: Fel Flame
desc: Born from demonic magic, these petulant little entities corrupt everything they touch with foul energies.

name: Borean Marmot
desc: Distinct from their cousins found in warmer climes, these hardy critters make their homes in the icy wastes of Northrend.

name: Horny Toad
desc: There are many scholars who question whether it is a toad or not.

name: Stinkbug
desc: A desert-dwelling insect which defends its eggs by spraying a foul, ogrelike scent.

name: Tundra Penguin
desc: Tundra penguins often gather in large groups on the ice for protection against aquatic threats. Unfortunately this makes them easy prey for humanoid hunters seeking meat, skins and other achievements.

name: Roach
desc: A nuisance to most, roaches' incredible survivability sets them apart from other species.

name: Ji-Kun Hatchling
desc: Deadly offspring of the Ancient Mother, Ji-Kun Hatchlings are considered sacred treasures in many cultures.

name: Smolderweb Hatchling
desc: Although born in the warm heights of Blackrock Spire, the smolderweb hatchling can survive most environments.

name: Dusk Spiderling
desc: Native to Duskwood, these eight-legged critters are often used as ingredients in alchemy potions.

name: Sea Gull
desc: The seagull is a coastal scavenger often found near the docks.

name: Mirror Strider
desc: When preparing to travel to distant locations, Pandaren will traditionally capture a mirror strider and safely relocate it to another body of water.

name: Rat
desc: The intrepid archaeologist Harrison Jones has a well documented fear of rats.

name: Igneous Flameling
desc: Who's ready for a hot stone massage?

name: Sting Ray Pup
desc: These fast and nimble swimmers are highly desired by pet collectors. Though they can appear friendly, their tail stinger can kill on contact.

name: Blighted Squirrel
desc: Undead squirrels have acquired a taste for the strange berries and mushrooms that now grow in Silverpine Forest.

name: Leopard Scorpid
desc: Loves to rest inside footwear of unsuspecting travelers during the night.

name: Yellow-Bellied Marmot
desc: Distinct from their plain dwelling relatives, these critters make their homes amidst the war-torn Twilight Highlands.

name: Temple Snake
desc: The Jade Forest's pandaren consider these reptiles distant relatives of the revered Jade Serpent, Yu'lon.

name: Imperial Eagle Chick
desc: The taunka collect the feathers of these noble birds of prey to use in crude fortunetelling ceremonies.

name: Tainted Rat
desc: There are some things too dirty even for rats.

name: Singing Sunflower
desc: This sweet flower will brighten your day with its warm smile and cheerful song! Also strong against undead.

name: Tree Frog
desc: Known for their powerful legs and keen eyesight.

name: Locust
desc: When the locusts swarm, you can hear nothing but the sound of their wings.

name: Thundering Serpent Hatchling
desc: A baby version of the mighty Thundering Cloud Serpent that hails from the far lands of Pandaria.

name: Panther Cub
desc: It looked up at you with those huge black eyes and seemed to ask, 'Are you my mommy?'

name: Plains Monitor
desc: While stationary, the plains monitor will continuously flick its tail back and forth. From a distance this mimics the appearance of swaying tallgrass, camouflaging the lizard from aerial predators.

name: Rapana Whelk
desc: Has been spotted fighting other whelks for prime food sources.

name: Ash Spiderling
desc: The rock-hard carapaces of these spiders allow them to survive in the Searing Gorge's blistering heat.

name: Rusty Snail
desc: Don't let their lack of a face fool you--these slimy critters are angry and just itching for a fight.

name: Silky Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell in the shadow of Nordrassil and feed on Stormvine nectar.

name: Infinite Hatchling
desc: The infinite dragonflight is far more diverse than most denizens of Azeroth know.

name: Land Shark
desc: After birth, newborn sharks quickly flee their hungry mothers. Their early independence makes them dangerous, even while young.

name: Spider
desc: The most common of the arachnid family, these critters spin their webs in nearly every corner of Azeroth.

name: Arctic Fox Kit
desc: During frigid nights in the Storm Peaks, these critters use their fluffy tails as a blanket to stay warm.

name: Grove Viper
desc: The Jade Forest's mountain hozen fear these venomous reptiles and often hunt them out of pure spite.

name: Bananas
desc: Although loath to part with Bananas, Landro realized it would be safer if the pet was far from Booty Bay when his father, King Mukla, discovered he was missing.

name: Infested Bear Cub
desc: Infested cubs still listen for the telltale buzzing of bees even though they can no longer taste honey.

name: Alpine Foxling
desc: Burrows deep into snowbanks to hide from predators.

name: Fossilized Hatchling
desc: You stare at her, and she just stares right back. So clever; sometimes it seems as if she's figuring out how to open doors.

name: Scooter the Snail
desc: You'll find him in his shell, exactly where a snail has to be!

name: Tiny Harvester
desc: The tiny harvester collects weeds and small grains that the larger reapers may have missed.

name: Black Rat
desc: While many people believe black cats to be bad luck, black rats are held in higher esteem.

name: Pierre
desc: Every cook's dream wrapped up in a perfect bundle of metal and bolts. Too bad what he cooks up isn't suitable for humanoid consumption. According to Jard's notes, he intends to make this little guy for his friend, Emily Cole.

name: Sand Scarab
desc: Easily mistaken for a common beetle, the sting of a sand scarab will quickly clear up the misconception should you be unlucky enough to be stung by one.

name: Desert Spider
desc: This cunning species tunnels beneath Uldum and erupts from the ground to ensnare its prey.

name: Bandicoon
desc: The taciturn bandicoon's diet consists mostly of apples.

name: Undercity Rat
desc: Even the rats of Lordaeron fell to the apothecaries' plague, chewing upon the tainted flesh of the dead.

name: Fjord Worg Pup
desc: There's an old vrykul saying that goes, 'Let sleeping worgs lie, unless you don't want your face anymore.'

name: Garden Moth
desc: Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to lightning storms.

name: Undercity Cockroach
desc: The cockroach is usually an impulse buy. Its owners have a hard time parting with it even after numerous attempts.

name: Sporeling Sprout
desc: These pudgy little beings often get themselves into trouble while hunting down their favorite snack: glow caps.

name: Shore Crawler
desc: Only found on the shores of Kezan, this lovely sea creature can be a bit snarky.

name: Westfall Chicken
desc: Don't call this bird chicken unless you want egg on your face.

name: Mojo
desc: Amani witch doctors have turned many victims into frogs. Some never recover.

name: Zipao Tiger
desc: A rarely seen family of tigers, many believe (perhaps incorrectly) that some residual magic or other event is responsible for the unique color.

name: Darkshore Cub
desc: The fur of the darkshore bears owes to the almost perpetual gloom they live in, and their vision in the darkness is uncanny.

name: Guardian Cub
desc: Still a little clumsy, this tiny winged lion is learning how to be the best mount it can be!

name: Azure Whelpling
desc: Like other members of the blue dragonflight, these whimsical little critters display an affinity to arcane magic.

name: Bombay Cat
desc: Donni Anthania plans to have a bombay buried with her when she dies. A wise adventurer can put its talents to much better use.

name: Clefthoof Runt
desc: For ogres, comparing a female's hair to a clefthoof's shaggy coat is a term of great endearment.

name: Water Waveling
desc: The trolls of Zul'Drak inadvertently created these little beings while summoning water elementals to fight the Scourge.

name: Jumping Spider
desc: This terrifying and highly venomous species leaps onto its prey from the Jade Forest's dense canopy.

name: Enchanted Lantern
desc: Reduces the likelihood of being eaten by monsters when you enter pitch-black places.

name: Mac Frog
desc: Flamboyantly colored and more exuberant than most frogs.

name: Magic Lamp
desc: Higitus figi- hockity pocki- abracadab- prestidig--oh, pinfeathers!

name: Siamese Cat
desc: Known for its blue eyes. Also considered a delicacy by giant murlocs.

name: Spiny Terrapin
desc: Angering a spiny terrapin will cause it to withdraw into its shell and begin to spin wildly towards an attacker.

name: Alpine Foxling Kit
desc: Occasionally sneaks bites of food from kills made by much larger animals.

name: Darkmoon Zeppelin
desc: Lacking the mines and rockets of its predecessor, this kid-friendly faire prize is a new favorite among Azeroth's children.

name: Topaz Shale Hatchling
desc: Prized by gem crafters, the undamaged carapace of a topaz hatchling can be used to create stunning inlays for rings and bracelets.

name: Fjord Rat
desc: If not for being extremely accident prone, the fjord rat might take over the world.

name: Garden Frog
desc: One of the stranger nuisances to horticulturalists, garden frogs can cause untold damage to gardens.

name: Marsh Fiddler
desc: Known to feast on the tasty plants in Valley of the Four Winds.

name: Stinker
desc: Stinker uses his aroma to repel predators and attract cats. He's much more successful with the former than the latter.

name: Lucky
desc: Lucky squeals when he's angry or when he's eating. Either way, you don't want to bother him.

name: Gilded Moth
desc: This delicate insect's wings are often sewn into clothing and armor.

name: Szechuan Chicken
desc: Will only lay eggs in bright light.

name: Zooey Snake
desc: These reptiles possess hooked scales, allowing them to slither up Kun-Lai Summit's rocky slopes and steep cliffs.

name: Mongoose Pup
desc: Mongoose pups prefer long grass where only their mothers can find them.

name: Leopard Tree Frog
desc: The leopard tree frog was named for the way it pounces from branch to branch.

name: Darkmoon Balloon
desc: It just floats along...

name: Crimson Whelpling
desc: Hailing from the Wetlands, this young dragon is just learning how to hunt, breathe fire, and go on cute destructive rampages.

name: Fluxfire Feline
desc: Originally created by the engineers in the bowels of Gnomeregan, the Fluxfire Feline is a marvel of modern engineering.

name: Blue Clockwork Rocket Bot
desc: Jepetto's top-selling toy this season, the bot's new blue chassis has children across Azeroth scrambling for this feisty battle bot.

name: Mini Thor
desc: Powerful artillery of the Terran army. The Thor is always the first one in and the last one out!

name: Anubisath Idol
desc: An anubisath idol from the Temple of Ahn'qiraj, infused with ancient qiraji magic.

name: Mini Mindslayer
desc: The bane of many an adventurer, to look into its eyes is to truly know madness.

name: Brown Snake
desc: The brown snake is native to Horde-controlled territories. It seems unremarkable until its victims are within range.

name: Lil' Smoky
desc: This tiny peacekeeper security bot is often outfitted with the latest arcane nullifiers and crowd pummelers. Not for the environmentally minded.

name: Jubling
desc: The legendary ale frog was believed to be extinct until the strange brews at the Darkmoon Faire brought them out of hiding.

name: Golden Dragonhawk Hatchling
desc: Once prized by dragonhawk breeders in Silvermoon. Stands out at night to predators, making it necessary to gain awareness at an early age.

name: Mulgore Hatchling
desc: A tallstrider's speed on open ground is unrivaled, so predators rely on stealth and pack tactics when hunting them.

name: Chrominius
desc: Opponents that face this fierce chromatic monstrosity just hope it doesn't have Time Stop!

name: Jungle Grub
desc: These little green grubs are native to wilds of Pandaria. Its verdant coloration camouflages it from would-be predators.

name: Kuitan Mongoose
desc: The mongoose is prized for its ability to drive off poisonous snakes.  Rikk-tikk-tikki-tikki-tchk!

name: Darkmoon Turtle
desc: This shelled reptile bravely protects the home on its back with an unwaveringly happy disposition.

name: Searing Scorchling
desc: Elder shaman have warned that wisps of Ragnaros, loyal servants of the Firelord, have taken to the Molten Front. Vigilance is advised.

name: Baby Ape
desc: Young apes quickly learn to hang from branches with their feet, leaving both hands free to fling objects at interlopers.

name: Untamed Hatchling
desc: One of Razorgore's eggs that miraculously survived in Blackwing Lair.

name: Tickbird Hatchling
desc: Unlike most of Geen the gorloc's 'mysterious eggs,' this one actually contained a living thing.

name: Baby Blizzard Bear
desc: This rare bear is bred for its small size and perpetually youthful appearance.

name: Tirisfal Batling
desc: Can sense an opponent's heartbeat through echolocation.

name: Jade Owl
desc: Jade is naturally rich with life and color, making it the perfect raw material for this gentle companion.  It is said the wind created by their wings can soothe the troubled mind.

name: Sapphire Cub
desc: While each cub is crafted in the same fashion, tiny imperfections in the gemstones create a unique personality when imbued with life.  They are, however, always playful and friendly.

name: Terrible Turnip
desc: And you thought turnips at the dinner table were bad.

name: Softshell Snapling
desc: Softshell turtle meat is considered a delicacy and is the key ingredient in soothing turtle bisque.

name: Mei Li Sparkler
desc: Feeds on small leaves and grass when full grown.

name: Hyacinth Macaw
desc: The jungle trolls train these birds to mimic calls for help in order to lure unsuspecting travelers into traps.

name: Imperial Moth
desc: The larval form of this moth is world-renowned for creating the finest silk in Azeroth.

name: Hippogryph Hatchling
desc: After a harpy incursion in Feralas, several hippogryph nesting grounds were attacked. Hundreds of hatchlings were orphaned, and they have been entrusted to the care of the druids on Sardor Isle.

name: White Moth
desc: Prefers flying during foggy nights, which are common in Azuremyst Isle.

name: Venus
desc: Seems odd that he doesn't like flies... right?

name: Jade Tentacle
desc: Careful now, she can get a bit frisky sometimes!

name: Diemetradon Hatchling
desc: Diemetradons abandon their hatchlings in Un'Goro Crater to fend for themselves. Only the strongest survive.

name: Mechanical Pandaren Dragonling
desc: Constructed from a seemingly impossible mass of gears, springs, wires, and a little something special, this dragonling embodies the spirit of Pandaria as seen through an engineer's goggles.

name: Lurky
desc: Lurky's charming disposition and lively antics are guaranteed to soothe frustration and lighten even the darkest moods.

name: Imperial Silkworm
desc: This plump red caterpillar is world-renowned for creating the finest silk in Azeroth.

name: Giant Bone Spider
desc: Found in a dusty egg clutch at the back of Maexxna's lair, these creatures are already undead when they hatch.

name: Ashstone Core
desc: The cooled core of Golemagg, it appears to retain some semi-sentient properties.

name: Lil' Deathwing
desc: Nations tremble under his shadow - the Destroyer, the one-time Aspect of Earth, and the monster responsible for breaking Azeroth asunder.  Now in a convenient travel-size!

name: Guild Page
desc: When a guild earns enough glory by defeating Alliance champions, some orcs will come to share the glory by serving the guild.

name: Bandicoon Kit
desc: Some druids say pandaren and raccoons are distant cousins, but never when a pandaren can hear them.

name: Pandaren Monk
desc: The pandaren monk is a fearless traveling companion, constantly training in his art... unless you offer him a drink. He considers it rude to refuse.

name: Winter's Little Helper
desc: During the majestic Winter Veil celebration, these faithful companions spread joy throughout the land. The rest of the year, they are busy.

name: Proto-Drake Whelp
desc: These voracious whelps grow at an incredible rate and can devour nearly twice their weight in raw meat per day.

name: Peanut
desc: Domesticated elekks are trained as mounts by the draenei people. In the wild they are hunted for their ivory tusks.

name: Toothy
desc: The crocolisk's hide and meat are prized by hunters, but the beast is ferocious and seldom taken by surprise.

name: Feline Familiar
desc: Ride with the moon (and this furry, whiskered witch) in the dead of night!

name: Lil' XT
desc: Modeled after the huge titan prototype in Ulduar, this volatile little construct plays hard with its toys.

name: Darkmoon Eye
desc: Don't even think about cheating now.

name: Dark Phoenix Hatchling
desc: Fire hatchlings are born from the ashes of a phoenix. Dark hatchlings emerge from their shadows.

name: Ammen Vale Lashling
desc: The long-term effects of the contamination caused by the Exodar are still under observation.

name: Ethereal Soul-Trader
desc: Ethereal soul-traders will travel with those who can free the essences they need from unruly hosts.

name: Ancona Chicken
desc: It thinks you taste like chicken too.

name: Nightsaber Cub
desc: Elune made nightsabers silver and black so they could meld into the shadows on a moonlit night.

name: Lil' Tarecgosa
desc: A legendary member of the blue dragonflight.

name: Vampiric Batling
desc: Vampire bats have been trained as scouts and mounts by the Forsaken of the Undercity and the Amani trolls of Zul'Aman.

name: Skunk
desc: Skunks are known as solitary creatures for reasons which are hopefully obvious.

name: Twilight Beetle
desc: An enigmatic species, said to feed off the chaotic energies of the Old Gods.

name: Grassland Hopper
desc: At night, the grassland hoppers fill the night with their maddening song. Those unaccustomed to it have spent many a sleepless night serenaded by their mating calls.

name: Silent Hedgehog
desc: These hedgehogs may be silent, but often are heard the cries of those that foolishly step upon their quills.

name: Tiny Green Dragon
desc: Legends say that these vibrant emerald beings bring good fortune and safe travels to their owners.

name: Senegal
desc: Favored pet of the goblins of Booty Bay, this colorful bird is renowned for its ability to count coins, tally budgets, and lie about contracts.

name: Firefly
desc: Commonly used by sporelings as a light source as they navigate the waterways of Zangarmarsh, this luminescent insect helps them avoid the dangerous bogflare needlers.

name: Egbert
desc: The sin'dorei use hawkstriders as mounts, but this little one was deemed unfit after being diagnosed with numerous anxiety disorders.

name: Jade Tiger
desc: Considered to be lucky, tigers carved of jade are prized, but taming a jade tiger itself is an even greater prize.

name: Prairie Dog
desc: Distinct from their tree dwelling cousins, these ground squirrels make their homes on the plains of Azeroth and beyond.

name: Leaping Hatchling
desc: This offspring of Takk the Leaper is incredibly agile and can maneuver through difficult environments with ease.

name: Tiny Shale Spider
desc: The elemental shale spider is no true arachnid, but it has durability and ferocity that make it feared even in Deepholm.

name: Redridge Rat
desc: The rats in Redridge grow fat from feasting on the bounty of the village larders.

name: Fungal Abomination
desc: Loatheb's body is covered in small pods capable of spreading blighted fungal spores up to 1000 yards given proper wind conditions.

name: Mr. Bigglesworth
desc: Upon exiting the freezing necropolis of Naxxramas, Mr. Bigglesworth promptly found a warm spot in the sun to take a long nap in.

name: Silver Pig
desc: Druids think silver pigs have a special bond with golden pigs, as both breeds appeared on Azeroth at the same time.

name: Nuts
desc: Most squirrels hoard acorns for sustenance. Nuts, on the other hand, hoards acorns to stock its supply of ammunition.

name: Brilliant Kaliri
desc: One of the rarest creatures, this kaliri is set apart from others by its brilliant plumage and the lengths hunters will go to capture them.

name: Crystal Beetle
desc: A cousin to the Twilight Beetle, this insect has learned to feed on crystals which resonate with ancient energies.

name: Eye of the Legion
desc: Always watching. Always judging.

name: Scourged Whelpling
desc: Kel'Thuzad once nursed a plague-infected whelp to adulthood, feeding it only the finest liquefied remains.

name: Mr. Wiggles
desc: Many assume 'Wiggles' refers to the motion of this pig's posterior. They discover the true meaning when they see their own entrails.

name: Blue Moth
desc: Delicate denizen of Azuremyst Isle, this magical insect has been rumored to possess healing abilities.

name: Spirit of Competition
desc: These stunning creatures, awarded to heroes for victory in battle, represent bravery and strength.

name: Mini Tyrael
desc: 'I am Justice itself!'

name: Emerald Shale Hatchling
desc: Adventurers have reported rare sightings of a monstrous sized emerald shale spider, which the denizens of Deepholm have come to call the Jadefang.

name: Pint-Sized Pink Pachyderm
desc: A shy creature, the pink elekk will only make its presence known to those that have befriended it, or to anyone too intoxicated to harm it.

name: Masked Tanuki
desc: There's a raging debate over whether tanukis are raccoons or dogs, but the distinction seems trivial when they're gnawing on your femur.

name: Bat
desc: This foreboding creature stalks the night skies of the Eastern Plaguelands, feeding on carrion.

name: Minfernal
desc: These ill-tempered constructs of flame and rage sometimes rise from the remains of larger infernals who fall in battle.

name: Widow Spiderling
desc: Widow spiderlings have plenty of time to explore Duskwood once they take care of their pesky family commitments.

name: Peddlefeet
desc: The power of love can be a dangerous thing, especially when wielded by an airborne, ill-tempered goblin.

name: Amethyst Shale Hatchling
desc: Adult amethyst shale spiders prefer to create their nests against the outer walls of Deepholm.

name: Panda Cub
desc: This pint-sized panda cub is highly sought after by adventurers around Azeroth - despite its narcoleptic nature.

name: Wolpertinger
desc: Many a drunken Brewfest goer has told the tale of this mysterious creature, but few remember that tale in the morning.

name: Scorpling
desc: Despite its snapping claws and venom-dripping tail, it is the bite of the diminutive scorpling that is the greatest threat.

name: Little Black Ram
desc: These rams hone their fighting skills by head-butting twigs and saplings near Loch Modan.

name: Larva
desc: This new arrival to Azeroth was spawned a short time ago. It seeks to thrive while awaiting its next phase of evolution.

name: Obsidian Hatchling
desc: This hatchling is coveted for its unique coloration. Despite Breanni's loving care, the raptor's feral nature cannot be restrained.

name: Polly
desc: Parrots can't get enough of the fresh fish the Bloodscalp trolls eat. They're less interested in dry flatbreads.

name: Elementium Geode
desc: Often confused by miners as a rare gem, the geode initially makes its presence known by emitting melodic reverberations.

name: Landro's Lichling
desc: How the goblin Landro Longshot initially came into possession of the lichling remains a mystery, but he was all too eager to wager it in a game of cards.

name: Frigid Frostling
desc: While not nearly as destructive as its original master, the Ice Lord Ahune, the frostling has been known to lob chilly snowballs at unsuspecting adventurers.

name: Stitched Pup
desc: When Gluth died to a band of brave adventurers, these lil' guys were found in the corpse, gnawing on giant, undead bones.

name: Shrine Fly
desc: This species of insect is drawn to the latent energy in shrines, their luminescent appearance adding to the mystique of the places of power.

name: Ash Lizard
desc: The ash lizard gets its name from the way its shed skin looks, with an appearance like burnt cinders.

name: Coral Adder
desc: The coral adder's venom is so deadly that one bite has been known to kill a full grown kodo beast.

name: Celestial Dragon
desc: Breanni in Dalaran, one of the world's foremost collectors of exotic pets, will only award the mystical Celestial Dragon to fellow collectors whose obsession rivals her own.

name: Elfin Rabbit
desc: Their proximity to the magic of the elves has caused some of them unnatural long life. And in some elfin rabbits...stranger things.

name: Enchanted Broom
desc: Created by a blood elf apprentice, this broom would be extremely useful if anyone could figure out how to make it stop.

name: Harbinger of Flame
desc: Few of these fiery harbingers remain following Ragnaros' defeat in the Firelands.

name: Calico Cat
desc: Many have mocked this cat before battle. Their last words are usually, 'Here, kitty, kitty.'

name: Festival Lantern
desc: The light from each lantern honors the soul of an ancestor spirit. During the Lunar Festival, these ghostly elders pass along their wisdom to the current generation.

name: Eternal Strider
desc: It seems like a trick to the eyes, but the eternal strider can walk across water, its small feet never breaking the surface.

name: Worg Pup
desc: Worgs are the favored companions of orcs and are fiercely loyal on the battlefield.

name: Sprite Darter Hatchling
desc: These adorable critters love snuggling with their owners after a long day of brutal, bloody battle.

name: Black Tabby Cat
desc: Old Alterac saying: 'A cat has nine lives, but needs only one.'

name: Snowshoe Rabbit
desc: If you go chasing snowshoe rabbits, you know you're going to fall.

name: Albino Snake
desc: A favored companion of Kirin Tor magi, this reptile makes one wonder whether it's truly a snake or something else altogether.

name: Razormaw Hatchling
desc: Razormaw eggs are protected fiercely by their mothers. Their cuteness belies their inherited ferocity.

name: Teldrassil Sproutling
desc: It always wakes up dancing. What a happy little tree!

name: Swamp Moth
desc: Prefers to dwell in wet, muddy areas and feed on Sorrowmoss nectar.

name: Death Talon Whelpguard
desc: A runt of the Black Talon, left to guard the whelps.

name: Beetle
desc: A hardy insect that can dwell in just about any climate, the beetle is known to thrive on battlefields after the fighting has ended.

name: Coral Snake
desc: Brave assassins sometimes capture these critters to use their highly toxic venom to poison weapons.

name: Elwynn Lamb
desc: Unlike the polymorphed variety, trueborn sheep can be quite scary.

name: Sen'jin Fetish
desc: This is actually three pets in one. You won't know what you'll get until you summon it!

name: Rustberg Gull
desc: This bird is a salty veteran of the endless naval battles surrounding Tol Barad--a veteran whose grown plump from picking through the leftovers, that is.

name: Terky
desc: Terky is as shy as she is adorable, preferring the company of close friends over new ones.

name: Viscidus Globule
desc: This small globule didn't make it back to Viscidus in time to re-form.

name: Warpstalker Hatchling
desc: After hatching, these twisted reptiles devour the weaker members of their clutches as an act of dominance.

name: Twilight Fiendling
desc: Demonstrating that a little evil goes a long way, this fiendling uses its razor-sharp teeth and gaping maw to devour anything in its path.

name: Toad
desc: The song of late summer nights is the song of toads.

name: Spotted Bell Frog
desc: The dwarven explorer who first discovered the spotted bell frog could not decide between naming it after the unique spot pattern or the sound of the frog's mating ritual. She chose both.

name: Summit Kid
desc: You'll often find them perched high atop impossibly high and remote stone outcroppings. There are few creatures as sure of foot.

name: Clock'em
desc: Created for one purpose and one purpose alone: to punch little critters, as hard as it possibly can.

name: Corefire Imp
desc: These tiny flame imps roam the Molten Core in large swarms and can replenish their numbers rapidly.

name: Jungle Darter
desc: In the jungle, every leaf could conceal a frog. Stop to check and it could be long gone.

name: Pandaren Water Spirit
desc: Water spirits are especially mischievous, and are known to frequent the canals of the Stormstout Brewery.

name: Durotar Scorpion
desc: The volatile Durotar scorpion is a fierce desert predator. It's known for only occasionally stinging its owner.

name: Gusting Grimoire
desc: A fel-tainted tome whose secrets are so terrible and bizarre that its pages have taken on an eerie semblance of life. Found on many a warlock's nightstand.

name: Grinder
desc: Mogu sorcerers, keepers of the secret to bringing stone to life, prefer these stolid companions over more beastly familiars.

name: Spectral Cub
desc: Capable of sitting in even the smallest of boxes, thanks to its ghostly nature.

name: Spawn of G'nathus
desc: Some Pandaren believe G'nathus to be an ancient Zandalari Loa left behind to guard the waters south of Lei Shen's island citadel.

name: Tiny Green Carp
desc: It is believed that the green coloration and stripes on the tiny green carp serve as camouflage in the waters of the Jade Forest, Valley of the Four Winds and the Krasarang Wilds. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Elder Python
desc: These snakes have been known to swallow gnomes in one gulp.

name: Swamp Croaker
desc: Probably best not to touch it.

name: Son of Animus
desc: Forged in the Throne of Thunder, these tiny creations are servants of the great Dark Animus.

name: Coilfang Stalker
desc: It is unknown how Lady Vashj empowers these Fen Striders with their mind-bending powers; even at an early age this creature shows significant psychic ability.

name: Dragonbone Hatchling
desc: These skulking little creatures hatch in nests built around the ancient dragon bones of central Northrend.

name: Withers
desc: A solemn reminder of what was lost when the Worldbreaker changed the face of Azeroth.

name: Pygmy Direhorn
desc: Don't pet the pointy end. Note: all of the ends are pointy.

name: Direhorn Runt
desc: The Zandalari breed specific Direhorn species for their small size for use as mounts.

name: Tiny White Carp
desc: These hardy fish can survive in a wide range of climates, from the snow capped mountains of Kun-Lai Summit to the temperate, salty waters of the oceans around Pandaria. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Zandalari Footslasher
desc: Even at this size, these raptors can eviscerate an entire cow in less than 10 seconds.

name: Pocket Reaver
desc: Sent through the Twisting Nether by the great Archimonde the Defiler to terrorize tiny civilizations with their medium-sized stomping noises.

name: Lesser Voidcaller
desc: The lanterns carried by Voidcallers bridge the realms of the living and the dead, and often attract wayward ghosts and spirits.

name: Darting Hatchling
desc: Rarely leaves nest until maturity. Enjoys conducting pranks on the nearby Razormaw nest.

name: Perky Pug
desc: Although small, pugs are very dangerous when provoked.

name: Nether Faerie Dragon
desc: Much like other faerie dragons, these playful and mystical flyers are born with a natural defense against magic.

name: Alliance Balloon
desc: Created to entertain children at the Darkmoon Faire, these magical balloons never lose their floatiness.

name: Fire-Proof Roach
desc: The outer member of the roaches' eggs protect the larva from incineration. It is here in incubation that they gain the ability to resist the fire and heat of the volcanic climate.

name: Zandalari Toenibbler
desc: These adorable beasts are both cuddly and huggable, provided you do not enjoy having a face.

name: Gahz'rooki
desc: The trolls have a long and storied history of summoning hydras. While he might not be the biggest or strongest hydra, Gahz'rooki will bite your fingers quite hard if you get too close.

name: Living Fluid
desc: The dark pools in Primordius' chamber laid stagnant after the fall of the mogu, and murky thoughts began to coalesce.

name: Phoenix Hawk Hatchling
desc: These brightly-colored dragonhawks carry Kael'thas' forces swiftly and unerringly through the nether storm surrounding the Eye.

name: Tito
desc: Though generally an expert at taking stage direction, the show had to be stopped on more than one occasion when Tito and Roar would lock eyes, resulting in an extended chase around the Karazhan Opera House.

name: Malayan Quillrat Pup
desc: Although the wounds caused by the young quillrat are seldom fatal, most predators seek easier prey.

name: Amber Moth
desc: Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to lightning storms.

name: Wild Jade Hatchling
desc: So cute, yet so epic.

name: Infected Fawn
desc: Only the dimwitted or insane would mount an infected deer head on their wall. The good news is they'll fit right in with their new undead friends.

name: Wanderer's Festival Hatchling
desc: Legend has it that a seadragon turtle just like this one grew up to become Shen-zin Su, the Wandering Isle. Perhaps your little turtle will grow into something amazing?

name: Stunted Direhorn
desc: Even at this tiny size, Direhorns are known to wreak havoc on unsuspecting victims.

name: Spectral Porcupette
desc: Something about this creature looks familiar...

name: Viscous Horror
desc: These malicious oozes are highly sensitive to Primordius' pheromone signature.

name: Harpy Youngling
desc: They only get more beautiful as they age.

name: Stunted Yeti
desc: Hunted by locals for years, this is an extremely rare specimen.

name: Lofty Libram
desc: Most people have never read this book.

name: Wild Golden Hatchling
desc: The offspring of Tsulong, hidden away before the corruption of the Sha had fully taken hold of the Terrace of Endless Spring.

name: Wild Crimson Hatchling
desc: It's red, so it must fly faster.

name: Singing Cricket
desc: Known to feast on the tasty plants in Krasarang Wilds.

name: Cornish Rex Cat
desc: Donni Anthania invites these cats to her tea parties. But she doesn't serve their favorite drink: the tears of their enemies.

name: Zandalari Anklerender
desc: These tiny minions of Zandalar are adept at stowing away within the cargo holds of the enormous Zandalari warships.

name: Filthling
desc: Battle pet trainers are strongly encouraged to wash their hands for at least 30 minutes after playing with the filthling.

name: Arcane Eye
desc: Never take your eye off of it.

name: Infinite Whelpling
desc: You better believe he knows what time it is.

name: Highlands Skunk
desc: This ferocious skunk can spray an attacker from thirty yards away, temporarily blinding them.  Handle with caution!

name: Landro's Lil' XT
desc: Always 'ready to play,' Landro's Lil' XT is almost indistinguishable from the original. Prone to tantrums and narcolepsy.

name: Lil' Ragnaros
desc: It's never too soon to summon this tiny aspect of the dread Firelord.

name: Mongoose
desc: Contrary to its benign appearance, mongoose are dangerous carnivores, well known for their ability to hunt venomous snakes that could kill much larger creatures.

name: Dancing Water Skimmer
desc: Named for their apparent dancelike behavior when skimming aquatic surfaces, the species uses erratic movements to avoid being devoured by fish and other underwater predators.

name: Zeradar
desc: Infamous psionic battering ram of the Protoss, Zeradar is also the only archon that can utilize psionic storm. Power overwhelming!

name: Xu-Fu, Cub of Xuen
desc: Fierce and loyal, Xu-Fu loves to hunt by moonlight.  Once during a full moon, he killed and ate an entire Ironfur Great Bull, prompting a two day nap.

name: Moon Moon
desc: Moonfang's cubs grow into massive, slavering, black-furred killing machines...except for Moon Moon.

name: Fishy
desc: Many believe (incorrectly) that goldfish have no memories. Trainers who have worked with them know this is clearly not the case and have the bruises to prove it.

name: Darkmoon Rabbit
desc: This rabbit is much stronger than it looks.

name: Chi-Ji Kite
desc: A beautiful kite brought to life by the scribes of Pandaria.

name: Lashtail Hatchling
desc: Born in the jungles of Stranglethorn, unlucky raptor hatchlings are often captured by the Gurubashi and taken to the troll city of Zul'Gurub.

name: Feverbite Hatchling
desc: The common folk remedy to a feverbite hatchling's bite is to dance wildly and try to sweat out the toxins before they can take hold.

name: Strand Crab
desc: The low tide reveals the colonies of strand crabs and the sound of their clicking dance as they feed upon small creatures hidden in the sand.

name: Wood Frog
desc: Vendors at the Darkmoon Faire offer strange and exotic wonders. They also sell wood frogs.

name: Chi-Chi, Hatchling of Chi-Ji
desc: Chi-Chi tries to inspire hope with her loud squawk and by chasing, and eventually eating, butterflies.

name: Zao, Calfling of Niuzao
desc: Always on the lookout for a fight or some tasty grass, Zao keeps his head down and eyes forward.

name: Lil' Bling
desc: This handsome little robot is the spitting image of his "Dad", Blingtron 4000.  As a Blingtron's generosity circuits don't mature until they have been built to maximum specification, you shouldn't expect any free handouts from him.

name: Tiny Bog Beast
desc: These small elementals cling to the backs of larger mire beasts, picking off tasty bugs and mites.

name: Fledgling Nether Ray
desc: Adult nether rays are relatively docile, but their younglings are short-tempered and highly energetic beasts.

name: Snowshoe Hare
desc: With the extra large surface area of their legs, snowshoe hares are able to effortlessly hop along the snow while their pursuers get bogged down in the drifts.

name: Tolai Hare
desc: In the ancient fables, the first Tolai hare strode across the gulf between the stars before it upset them and they tumbled from the heavens to the world below.

name: Feral Vermling
desc: It keeps looking at me. I think it wants to bite me.

name: Baneling
desc: A rolling, explosive member of the Zerg swarm, the baneling deals terrible, terrible damage. Very dangerous in close quarters.

name: Black Kingsnake
desc: Xan'tish fearlessly tracks, captures, and trains these noble snakes so they will aid their comrades in battle.

name: Tiny Red Carp
desc: The red scales on these fish are believed to be a warning to predators of the Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes that their flesh is toxic. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Blossoming Ancient
desc: This budding ancient is a unique variety in Azeroth, created from the ever-living branches of the Great Tree, and can bloom in any season.

name: Yu'la, Broodling of Yu'lon
desc: A master sculptor devoted her life to creating an incomparably beautiful statue, inspired by her love and reverence for Yu'lon.  When the sculptor passed away, Yu'lon breathed a fraction of her essence into the statue, bringing Yu'la into the world.

name: Spring Rabbit
desc: Spring rabbits symbolize fertility, and they love to demonstrate why.

name: Lifelike Toad
desc: Talented engineers have crafted an exact replica of a wood frog, at only ten times the cost of buying the real thing.

name: Guild Herald
desc: When guilds have accumulated enough wealth, brave soldiers are often called to bear their standards.

name: Sumprush Rodent
desc: A rodent of usual size.

name: White Kitten
desc: 'The queen had three kittens. The first gave her a juicy rat. The second, a tasty hare. And the white, her favorite, presented the head of her rival.'

name: Hawk Owl
desc: This dark-feathered bird of prey is often seen as a harbinger of doom amongst the druids of Teldrassil.

name: Lil' Bad Wolf
desc: The oft-forgotten offspring of the Big Bad Wolf, found gorged and asleep in a basket of sweets.

name: Menagerie Custodian
desc: Primary responsibilities include dusting Medivh's many magical artifacts, an activity which has claimed the life, sanity, or physical composition of the many caretakers preceding Moroes.

name: Strand Crawler
desc: The strand crawler has adapted to the northern cold by hibernating under the island beaches.

name: Silver Tabby Cat
desc: Sleeping is this cat's second favorite activity. The first is yawning.

name: Yu'lon Kite
desc: Who knew scribes could make kites?

name: Darkmoon Monkey
desc: The monkeys of Azeroth are infamous tricksters, and these beloved companions of the Darkmoon Faire have taken that innate cunning to a whole new level.

name: Emperor Crab
desc: The emperor crab was named for its regal appearance: the ridges of its shell and its raised claws eerily resembling a crown. One that would pinch your eyes out if you tried to wear it.

name: Rabbit
desc: When you have two rabbits, you'll often soon have three.

name: Netherspace Abyssal
desc: Upon leaving Netherspace, Malchezaar's Abyssals become strangely distorted by Karazhan's magical protections, rendering them tiny, and much less likely to spontaneously erupt in flames.

name: Fiendish Imp
desc: A minion of Terestian Illhoof, this tricky imp was left in Karazhan when the portal to the Twisting Nether closed behind it.

name: Horned Lizard
desc: Not only is it quick, it's loud too!

name: Restless Shadeling
desc: These creatures are silent, save for the occasional sigh of otherworldly despair.

name: Highlands Turkey
desc: Capable of flying, unlike domesticated types.

name: Red-Tailed Chipmunk
desc: According to the tales of the night elves, the first red-tailed chipmunk was colored so after the theft and consumption of a sacred apple.

name: Yellow Moth
desc: Prefers flying during thunderstorms, which are common in Azuremyst Isle.

name: Tiny Blue Carp
desc: These little guys can be found in the waters of the Timeless Isle, or swimming alongside Jewel Danio or Redbelly Mandarin. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Tideskipper
desc: An astounding find for the scientific community of Azeroth, who have long pondered, often in taverns, what a baby Sea Giant might look like.

name: Tainted Waveling
desc: The spawn of Hydross, considered by the elemental community to be the "Earl of Puddles."

name: Chicken
desc: Tends to avoid crossing roads, regardless of motivations.

name: Pandaren Air Spirit
desc: These spirits represent the heart of Pandaria's elemental powers.

name: Spirit of Summer
desc: This little piece of summer smells of warm evenings and lightning storms. If you look closely, you might be able to make out a face.

name: Argent Gruntling
desc: These young orcs strive to embody the Argent Crusade's virtues: valor, strength, and integrity.

name: Murkimus the Gladiator
desc: Murkimus is the most fearsome of all murloc arena warriors. And for a time, the only one.

name: Warbot
desc: A fighting robot fueled by delicious red or blue electrolytes.

name: Red Cricket
desc: Be careful, he might eat all your crops!

name: Anodized Robo Cub
desc: The engineering wizards in Everlook created this unique cub as a test model.  Unfortunately a few went rogue and were never recovered.

name: Cogblade Raptor
desc: This model of raptors is produced in the Blade's Edge Mountains.  Their robotic roars are a common sound near Toshley Station.

name: Nexus Whelpling
desc: The runts of Malygos brood, these whelplings are prized for their boundless arcane magics.

name: Pandaren Earth Spirit
desc: The elements of Pandaria can be cute and playful, until their homeland is threatened.

name: Darkmoon Glowfly
desc: Their eerie green light, reminiscent of fel flames, is occasionally seen flitting through the twisted trees of Darkmoon Island.

name: Snake
desc: Due to recent accidents, the goblin cartels have prohibited anyone from bringing snakes on a zeppelin.

name: Hopling
desc: The great big world can be a dangerous place for such a tiny, adorable creature.

name: Aqua Strider
desc: Water striders serve an important role in Jinyu culture, acting as a mount, means of sending communications, and even a family pet.

name: Pandaren Fire Spirit
desc: Though it appears to be a vaguely-related cousin to the Cinder Kitten, the two creatures actually share no ancestry.

name: Kun-Lai Runt
desc: Indigenous to the peaks of Kun-Lai Summit, this rare yeti is much more dangerous than it looks.

name: Emerald Proto-Whelp
desc: These beautiful drakes can be found across the shores of Northrend.

name: Murki
desc: Murki is one of the world's rarest species of murloc.

name: Living Sandling
desc: Born of sand, these dangerous creatures can form and disperse in the blink of an eye.

name: Hyjal Bear Cub
desc: The cubs of Hyjal suffered much during the Cataclysm. On the bright side, the devastation also led to their newfound love of heights and daredevil stunts.

name: Fire Beetle
desc: Drawn to heat and the smell of smoke, the fire beetle's diet consists of ash.

name: Dung Beetle
desc: A desert dwelling forager attracted to areas rich with dung.

name: Stormie
desc: As an egg, this proto-drake was struck by a freak bolt of lightning. Years later, the lightning still lives inside.

name: Storm-Touched Bluefeather
desc: Peck. Peck. Zap!

name: Storm-Touched Stomper
desc: This what your mother always warned you would happen if you ate grass that was struck by lightning.

name: Water Snake
desc: Brought to Orgrimmar aboard merchant ships, these short-lived reptiles are considered pests by the city's residents.

name: Darkmoon Hatchling
desc: Most of Violet's numerous forest strider hatchlings are turned into Faire fare by Stamp Thunderhorn, though a few are raised as mounts or purchased by adventurers looking for a petite purple pet.

name: Twilight Spider
desc: Twisted by the Twilight Hammer's dark magic, these sinister critters are known to feed on their own young.

name: Twilight Iguana
desc: Although most reptiles enjoy basking in sunlight, these scaly beasts love bathing in the glow of Azeroth's twin moons.

name: Fawn
desc: Pay attention to deer crossings. Even a fawn will total a goblin trike.

name: Cinder Kitten
desc: A playful, purring pyromaniac. Don't pet these kittens without fireproof mittens!

name: Deviate Hatchling
desc: The demand for this purple-skinned breed has drastically reduced the raptor population near the Wailing Caverns.

name: Mr. Grubbs
desc: The grubs of the Plaguelands are a side effect of necromantic corruption and the massive number of corpses there. Mr. Grubbs is from a particularly acrobatic breed.

name: Venomspitter Hatchling
desc: These eight-legged critters have lurked in the shadowy cliffs of the Stonetalon Mountains for millennia.

name: Crow
desc: While smaller than the infamous ravens of Gilneas, crows are no less clever or cunning.

name: Parrot
desc: Parrots can mimic speech, but have difficulty with meaningful conversation.

name: Crested Owl
desc: Many owls nest high in the stone structures of Darnassus, hunting any pests that enter the night elves' city.

name: Shimmering Wyrmling
desc: This extremely rare species of mana wyrm is prized for its unique coloration and even temperament.

name: Darkmoon Cub
desc: This snuggly kitten loves to frolic, but sometimes it seems to be chasing things that aren't really there.

name: Sunreaver Micro-Sentry
desc: Loyal to the Sunreavers from creation, these pint-sized constructs can still pack a punch.

name: Electrified Razortooth
desc: Lightning can be seen flowing across its body, teeth to tail.

name: Zandalari Kneebiter
desc: This unique raptor was born on the island of Zandalar and transported here along with the rest of the Zandalari army.

name: Rocket Chicken
desc: When the Burning Legion invaded Outland, Landro Longshot contributed this design to the war effort. Both the Alliance and Horde passed on production.

name: Scarab Hatchling
desc: Spawn of the nefarious Shrieker Scarabs of Ahn'Qiraj, the hatchlings are much more docile (and quiet) than their parents.

name: Stunted Shardhorn
desc: The fierce wolvar hunt these ill-tempered brutes for their horns, which are then carved into talismans and other trinkets.

name: Devouring Maggot
desc: Howling Fjord teems with the ever shifting cycle of life. When a creature dies, its body is quickly consumed by maggots, which in turn pass those nutrients on to a number of other creatures.

name: Oily Slimeling
desc: These living blobs of ooze lack even the most rudimentary form of intelligence, but that doesn't mean they can't be your friend.

name: Ashleaf Spriteling
desc: The Ashleaf Sprites of the Timeless Isle tirelessly protect the vegetation of the island from the burning fury of Ordos and his minions.

name: Dandelion Frolicker
desc: While fascinated by flowers, the frolicker has also been known to dance with blades of grass and the occasional weed.

name: Alterac Brew-Pup
