name: Utility Mechanoclaw
desc: As handy as this invention is, it was also programmed to absolutely despise hand puns.

name: Wailing Lasher
desc: This lasher does not come from a black lagoon, or from the stars, or from beyond the moon. It just wants you to feed it.

name: Microbot XD
desc: One of the microbots used to guard the city of Rustbolt, now purchasable for a reasonable price.

name: Slimy Hermit Crab
desc: The slime on this provides essential nutrients to the hermit crab within, allowing it to go years without eating anything if it chooses.

name: Slimy Sea Slug
desc: Slimy sea slugs secrete slimy sea slug slime on the slimy sea floor.

name: Rikki
desc: Rikki has a talent for sneaking in and out of all manner of small spaces, if bribed properly with figs.

name: Needleback Pup
desc: The needleback porcupines have survived life in island climates by evolving to be extra lucky.

name: Albino Duskwatcher
desc: Albino ravens are incredibly rare and highly prized amongst the traders of the Great Sea.

name: Shadefeather Hatchling
desc: Though barely a hatchling, its claws are already sharp enough to pierce the flesh of many smaller critters.

name: Lord Woofington
desc: Lord Woofington was given his title after the rest of the denizens of Havenswood succumbed to madness.

name: Pearlescent Glimmershell
desc: When the sun shines on its shell just right, the light scatters in a thousand different directions.

name: Microbot 8D
desc: He's just so happy to be programmed to exist.

name: Spraybot 0D
desc: Even he cannot put out the fire in my heart.

name: Armored Vaultbot
desc: A walking vault that throws its money at you is not a very secure vault to own.

name: Rebuilt Gorilla Bot
desc: The convenient part of robots that fight each other is that you can just put them back together. Step two is to attach a giant laser cannon to ensure you win the next battle.

name: Rebuilt Mechanical Spider
desc: Anyone serious about using a mechanical spider in battle knows that you need to buy replacement legs in bulk. Those things are fragile.

name: Albatross Hatchling
desc: The Albatross is capable of flying further than any other species of bird on all of Azeroth.

name: Firesting Buzzer
desc: Firesting wasps are said to have one of the worst bites of any wasp species, causing a pain like a burning blaze.

name: Lustrous Glimmershell
desc: A gift, found one day and saved for a meaningful occasion, should things ever turn around.

name: Jenafur
desc: This cat is known for her lies, ignore her sweet meows.

name: Plagueborn Slime
desc: In Maldraxxus, plague has a strange habit of finding its way back to you.

name: Burnout
desc: Burnout always has a supply of well toasted marshmallows.

name: Crimson Bat Pup
desc: Unlike most other bat species, the crimson bats are actually blind and rely entirely on echolocation to get around.

name: Cobalt Raven
desc: The feathers of the cobalt raven glow eerily in the moonlight, making them easy to spot during the night.

name: Violet Abyssal Eel
desc: The Abyssal Eels are able to swallow and digest something up to twice the width of their body.

name: Tonguelasher
desc: It has one solution to all of its problems: give em' a lashing.

name: Scritches
desc: Key activities include: rolling over, sunning self, whimpering for belly scratches, and enjoying belly scratches.

name: Brilliant Glimmershell
desc: A gift, found one day and saved for a meaningful occasion, should things ever turn around.

name: Void-Scarred Hare
desc: Only a being of immense power could scar such an adorable creature, unless this hare was already approaching the darkness...

name: Void-Scarred Cat
desc: This cat eats anything from random scraps of food to strange glowing cubes of immense power. Be careful in front of its mouth.

name: Void-Scarred Rat
desc: A recent debate has risen up about whether Void-Scarred rats are better or worse than plagued rats.

name: Anomalus
desc: This ooze leaves behind a slimy trail as it moves that has a stench that would rival a beast rotting in the dunes of Uldum for a thousand years.

name: Void-Scarred Beetle
desc: The shell on these beetles is quite brittle from the void interference, but it also has a strangely fast regeneration rate.

name: Reek
desc: This little guy grows an additional eye somewhere on its body every year. It rhymes with...

name: K'uddly
desc: His tentacles give you the best hug your brain has ever felt.

name: Corrupted Tentacle
desc: Where did it come from, where does it go? Where did you come from, creepy tentacle?

name: Rotbreath
desc: Dragonbreath Chili is nothing compared to the stench coming from the mouth of this thing.

name: Muar
desc: The thirst for mana is insatiable, luckily this little one doesn't consume a whole lot.

name: Void-Scarred Anubisath
desc: N'Zoth's corruption spread across many beings, including this little Anubisath.

name: Aqir Hivespawn
desc: The aqir hive has countless numbers of beings in it, all of which are supportive of the ever-present Hivemind.

name: Ra'kim
desc: The winged aqir are very fast and agile, and their wings provide a nice breeze on a warm afternoon.

name: Aqir Tunneler
desc: These Aqir Scarabs are masters at tunneling through any terrain.

name: Pygmy Camel
desc: These Pygmy Camels are often mistaken for Mysterious Camel Figurines.

name: Eye of Corruption
desc: This creepy eye is looking at everyone, always, and only has to blink once every 10,000 years.

name: Gloop
desc: It is very unclear whether this slime started with all of those eyes inside of it, or if those are "leftovers".

name: C'Thuffer
desc: It is always C'Thuffer. Always.

name: Cursed Dune Watcher
desc: This little guy was exiled and cursed by other watchers of Uldum to spend the rest of its time as a tiny insignificant being.

name: Wicked Lurker
desc: Three legs, two arms, three eyeballs, the extras are for emergency situations only.

name: Jade Defender
desc: Several adventurous miners have gone after the jade quilen in search of riches, but none have ever been heard from again.

name: Windfeather Chick
desc: Despite what the young pandaren may tell you, the windfeather cranes do not actually have feathers made out of wind.

name: Oasis Void-Duster
desc: Nobody is sure what sort of powder is coming off of these moths, and everyone is too terrified to find out what it actually is.

name: Void-Scarred Locust
desc: Even some of the insects have succumbed to the void. They really do adapt and survive through everything.

name: Voidskimmer
desc: These look especially magnificent when gliding over the water under a full moon.

name: Voidglower
desc: Is the void glow in addition to their natural glow, or does it replace it? The world may never know.

name: Golden Chirper
desc: The golden chirper has managed to stay its pristine self, despite corruption attempts from both the Sha and from the forces of N'Zoth.

name: Shadowbarb Hatchling
desc: Void magic and giant flying insects, a combination nobody ever asked for. Surprisingly effective!

name: Chirpy Valeshrieker
desc: Despite the adorable name, the chirp is more of a horrible, spine-tingling shriek.

name: Cloudfeather Fledgling
desc: These ferocious flying creatures scrape their beaks against hard surfaces to sharpen them and intimidate foes.

name: Spriggan Trickster
desc: Spriggans are tricky foes that live in Ardenweald and torment the Night Fae. This one has decided to play the ultimate trick--joining you.

name: Death Seeker
desc: What horrors these eyes have seen in the tower of Torghast, with their unsleeping, unblinking gaze?

name: Gorm Harrier
desc: If you count the number of times its wings beat per minute, you can calculate how long it will be until this little terror will sting you.

name: PHA7-YNX
desc: Inspired by the phalynx of Bastion, Engineers have modified the design to be approximately 300% more adorable.

name: Amber Glitterwing
desc: Much like how a squid can squirt ink to escape in the water, a glitterwing can shake the dust off of its wings and similarly vanish.

name: Fuzzy Shimmermoth
desc: Shimmermoths don't actually shimmer in the sunlight. Nobody knows who named these, but they have a lot to answer for.

name: Starry Dreamfoal
desc: When a full moon is visible, streaks of hair on the dreamfoal's mane start to shimmer and glow like shooting stars.

name: Spinebug
desc: You got spinebugged!

name: Lost Quill
desc: No longer lost, it's now considering a name change.

name: Glimr
desc: A wandering adventurer saved a small band of murlocs that had lost their homes, and a glimmer of hope was born.

name: The Count
desc: Roosting in the grounds of Castle Nathria, The Count did not foresee falling into an eternal stone slumber.

name: Sinfall Screecher
desc: Joining with their new residents in Sinfall a few of these juvenile dredbats accompanied Renathal's forces into the maw.

name: Willowbreeze
desc: When the winds blow just right, howling through the canyons of Ardenweald, you can find these foals running with the wind in a spectacular show of prowess and color.

name: Hungry Burrower
desc: While these gormlings may not be the fastest diggers, they are very efficient and can move long distances underground before tiring.

name: Sunny
desc:
All dogs go to Bastion. 

Cats go to Revendreth.

name: Dread
desc: Staring at one of these creates a deep void of emotion at the very core of your being, then fills it with a sense of dread.

name: Sharpclaw
desc: The razor sharp claws will tear into anything with ease, making for an excellent emergency can opener.

name: Ruffle
desc: Plucking a feather from a steward is considered a sin worthy of a trip to Revendreth.

name: Jiggles
desc: Though not very fuzzy, this slimy feline is still one of the most adorable things you've ever seen.

name: Grubby
desc: These little slugs will try to eat literally anything they scoot over.

name: Gorm Rootstinger
desc: The sting from these gorm is incredibly painful and often inflicts temporary paralysis, even on large targets.

name: Gorm Needler
desc: There are more sharp pointy things on this species of gorm than there are on a Horde capital city.

name: Stoneskin Dredwing Pup
desc: These dredbats are built by the Stonewright for the Court of Harvesters. They are bonded to their owners and become fierce fighters.

name: Rosetipped Spiderling
desc: Identified by the signature coloring of their many legs, these spiders are known for elaborate dances used to threaten and confuse foes.

name: Devouring Animite
desc: No one knows where the devourers came from, but it is theorized that they flourish on several lost land masses in the In-Between.

name: Bleak Skitterer
desc: Legends say that if you see a bleak skitterer in your dreams, you are destined to battle one to the death.

name: Animated Cruor
desc: These slimy creatures make the strangest suction noises when they try to climb up a wall. This is a well-known fact in Maldraxxus, for obvious reasons.

name: Ashen Chomper
desc: Sometimes it is best to leave what strange creature you found in a mysterious jar in the depths of Torghast alone.

name: Maw Stalker
desc: These guardians of Torghast are always watching for suspicious activity.

name: Tranquil Wader
desc: Part of the wildlife of Ardenweald, they sometimes sleep while standing straight up in the water.

name: Necroray Spawnling
desc: Toxic spores rain down wherever these creatures fly, turning small, unwary critters into a gruesome feast.

name: Pearlwing Heron
desc: The whooping noise these pets make when hungry will rival any tormented cry you can find in Torghast.

name: Maw Crawler
desc: The mysterious forces that animate this mobile mitt don't seem particularly evil, yet.

name: Preyhunter's Prismguard
desc: A floating heart of magic drives a body made for the finish.

name: Frenzied Mawrat
desc: Its teeth are razor sharp and will chew through just about anything.

name: Lavender Nibbler
desc: Poking a tiny gormlng in the side makes a very satisfying, squishy noise. It is NOT advisable to poke one too many times.

name: Bound Lightspawn
desc: Lightspawn can always be found on the battlefields where light touches, no matter what form it takes.

name: Animated Tome
desc: Beware awakening the power of knowledge.

name: Burdened Soul
desc: A soul burdened with the sins of its past.

name: Torghast Lurker
desc: That eerie feeling you get when the shadows seem to shift and follow you isn't just a feeling, it's usually one of these.

name: Will of Remornia
desc: Remornia has been exposed to untold amounts of evil and sin, and will siphon power from any available source to fuel its desires.

name: Undying Deathroach
desc: This species has a very distinct set of markings on its back that makes it easy to identify in the unending horrors of the Maw.

name: Lost Soul
desc: A soul, having faced the sins of the past, wanders lost in the recent turmoil of the Shadowlands.

name: Primordial Bogling
desc: The sludge that can give rise to the dredgers has been known to coalesce and run a muck.

name: Archivist's Quill
desc: A good friend to Archivist Fane since his earliest days, Janeera is ready for him to let the quill go as she feels he is getting too attached.

name: Decaying Mawrat
desc: Tiny flakes of skin seem to perpetually fall off of this horrible creature, leaving behind a trail and a very distinct, foul odor.

name: Wrathling
desc: Drawn from an overabundance of pride and wrath these manifestations seek even more to sustain themselves.

name: Raw Emotion
desc: These creatures manifest in the catacombs beneath Revendreth due to vile rituals practiced on souls there.

name: Spinemaw Gormling
desc: While young, they have an adorable face and cute little antennae. While grown up, they gain razor sharp pinchers and are unstoppable eating machines. Life is full of compromises.

name: Renny
desc: If you received points for causing mischief while teleporting around as a tiny adorable vulpin, Renny would be on top of the leaderboard.

name: Court Messenger
desc: The stone fiends were created to serve as messengers and spies for the realm of Revendreth, and those of the Court of Harvesters serve that role extremely well.

name: Trapped Stonefiend
desc: Trapped in a chest and forgotten for years, this stone fiend is mad and looking for a fight.

name: Dal
desc: A fellow message courier to Chip, Dal was always on time until one day when he did not return from his appointed round.

name: Crimson Dredwing Pup
desc: A wild dredbat, the crimson pups are tough to tame. Their elusiveness and hardiness set them apart from their kin.

name: Dusky Dredwing Pup
desc: This dredwing is the most common of the dredbats, seen throughout the entire realm.

name: Mire Creeper
desc: Hiding among the reeds near muck pools, juvenile mire creepers patiently waiting for easy prey to approach.

name: Withering Creeper
desc: Subsisting on the residual anima in the waste of the Endmire, these mire creepers are withering away, yet in their famished state they are doubly dangerous.

name: Rocky
desc: The claws of a vulpin sharpen themselves naturally when walking around on any sort of cobblestone or rocky surface.

name: Violet Dredwing Pup
desc: A rare mutation gives this dredbat its violet underbelly, making it a sought after gift for pet collectors with eclectic tastes.

name: Dodger
desc: Dodger is a bit small relative to other vulpin, but is excellent at playing hide and seek.

name: Floofa
desc: Floofa smells like citrus fruits when its fur is wet.

name: Gloober, as G'huun
desc: Even the terrifying G'huun was, perhaps, once this cute.

name: Vicious Leporid
desc: Some leporids are docile and cute. Others are... still cute.

name: Volatile Venomfang
desc: The youngest venomfangs have the deadliest bites.

name: Pernicious Bonetusk
desc: The tusks on these creatures are fused to their skulls in such a manner that they feel no pain when charging or ramming into anything.

name: Boneweave Hatchling
desc: Maldraxxus is full of mighty and terrifying creatures, causing most denizens to be abnormally calm when around the indigenous species of giant spiders.

name: Clinging Remains
desc: Not quite alive, not quite dead, simply an arm, with no head.

name: Invasive Buzzer
desc: Gorm find a way to invade just about anywhere, and the Maw is no exception.

name: Amaranthine Stinger
desc: Though the spawn of a gorm queen lost within the Maw, this pet appears to be untainted by the Jailer's foul magics.

name: Bufonid Croaker
desc: The signature song of the bufonid croaker can be heard across vast distances.

name: Invertebrate Oil
desc: Is the ooze holding the bones in, or are the bones holding the ooze together?

name: Foulwing Buzzer
desc: The barbed mandibles on this species will dig deep into anything they bite, causing a lot of irritation.

name: Golden Cloudfeather
desc: A group of teroclaws is known as a fleece.

name: Writhing Spine
desc: Some predators in Maldraxxus collect spines as trophies, and some of them don't stop moving even then.

name: Scurrying Mawrat
desc: The nails of the mawrat can inflict one of several afterlife-ending illnesses.

name: Archetype of Discovery
desc: One part facial sphere, one part cube manufactory, one part successful curiosity.

name: Silvershell Snapper
desc: Terrapins prefer any sort of berry as their primary source of food, though they will eat almost anything.

name: Devoured Wader
desc: When newly-hatched, they start with colorless, white feathers. Within weeks, they flourish into a wide spectrum of beautiful colors.

name: Scarlet Proto Avian
desc: The distinctive red coloration of scarlet proto avians makes it difficult for them to hide from predators, which ironically means they're very hard to find.

name: Lost Limb
desc: Fragments of souls abound in the Maw, searching for meaning, or an end to their torment. But some just want to give you a hand.

name: Archetype of Multiplicity
desc: One part duplication, two parts duplication, four parts duplication... oops.

name: Winterleaf Spriggan
desc: The allegiances of the spriggan are as changing as the seasons.

name: Stemmins
desc: Whatever you do, don't ask it to carry a bucket of water. We don't talk about what happened to that area of the Shadowlands.

name: Battie
desc: Roosting over Sinfall, Battie was roused one evening by the music of the first Ember Court. She has not missed a single one since.

name: Fledgling Teroclaw
desc: Young teroclaws are surprisingly effective hunters and will attempt to bring down prey up to twice their size.

name: Helpful Glimmerfly
desc: A glimmerfly can load up nearly fifty percent of its weight as pollen and still retain full agility while flying.

name: Vibrant Glimmerfly
desc: The wings of glimmerflies are almost always saturated with some sort of pollen, causing a very steady flow of glittery dust to fall off of them as they fly.

name: Wild Corpsefly
desc: Corpsefly eggs end up everywhere in Maldraxxus, and are easily transported accidentally.

name: Micromancer
desc: Even the smallest bones don't go to waste in Maldraxxus.

name: Sludge Feeler
desc: It is not advisable to hug a sludge feeler. Those stains never wash out.

name: Toenail
desc: If you can beat them, stitch them!

name: Stony
desc: Abandoned by its master in a secluded room, the little bat has been hibernating in stone for ages.

name: Fun Guss
desc: This particular tiny tree is infested with strange spores and doesn't seem to mind.

name: Glimmerpool Hatchling
desc: Contrary to popular belief, a terrapin's diet has nothing to do with its shell color.

name: Brightscale Hatchling
desc: These brightly-colored terrapins are the least commonly seen in the wild. It is considered a sign of luck if you rub the top of its shell.

name: Luminous Webspinner
desc: The bright color of the luminous webspinner taunts would-be predators to chase them into their webs.

name: Plaguelouse Larva
desc: A parasite that latches onto some of the larger beasts of Maldraxxus and drinks until fully-grown, one wonders how the beasts don't manage to notice.

name: Leafadore
desc: These saplings grow unnaturally quickly when given enough anima, and their leaves are razor sharp when fully grown.

name: Trootie
desc: As long as any fragment of this species is found and planted, it will regrow into the same magnificent species as it once was.

name: Sable
desc: Vulpin actually have very light-colored skin, but their incredibly thick coats hide any color from showing through.

name: Goldenpaw Kit
desc: The golden vulpin are notorious for loud, barking yowls that echo across the plains of Bastion.

name: Purity
desc: Despite having a very fine coat of fur, young vulpin do not shed at all.

name: Zesty
desc: His bite has a zing to it.

name: Oonar's Arm
desc: The thrill of battle and the grip of war have not yet left the bones of Oonar.

name: Corpulent Bonetusk
desc: A newborn bonetusk has no visible tusks, but within weeks their tusks grow to a size proportional to their body.

name: Runelight Leaper
desc: This pet has tremendous airborne agility and will always land on its feet, even when flung by a home-made spring-loaded leaper-flinger.

name: Sir Reginald
desc: No one is quite sure where Reginald got his or her name, but what we do know is they don't answer to anything else.

name: Copperfur Kit
desc: How is a vulpin different than a fox? That is a good question.

name: Gilded Wader
desc: These golden-feathered creatures do not lay golden eggs, for that you would need a golden goose.

name: Indigo
desc: The mane on this tiny foal reflects a majestic indigo color when the light hits it in just the right way.

name: Spirited Skyfoal
desc: Few things are as adorable as a young skyfoal.

name: Shimmerbough Hoarder
desc: These critters are capable of holding a tremendous amount of food in their cheeks for easy transportation between hiding spaces.

name: Rustfur Kit
desc: Rarely, one of these kits is born to a golden-furred vulpin. It is considered a sign of distress in the pack.

name: Fluttering Glimmerfly
desc: For some reason, these blue glimmerflies are often afraid of water.

name: Wader Chick
desc: If you mat their silvery feathers down very carefully, it almost forms a mirror-like surface.

name: Wild Etherwyrm
desc: These flying creatures do not leave feathers out in the wild. If a feather happens to ever detach from their body, the feather glows brilliantly for a moment and then vanishes from sight.

name: Corpselouse Larva
desc: Though they are quite squishy while young, the bloodlouse will eventually grow hardened plates around its entire body.

name: Grip of Terror
desc: These ensorcelled gauntlets are used by the mawsworn to capture escaping prisoners.

name: Grappling Gauntlet
desc: Struggle all you want, it will just grip harder.

name: Irongrasp
desc: There was once a mawsworn so vile that he was killed by his own minions. So great was his malice that a fragment of him lives on in this glove.

name: Deathroach
desc: A species of wild pest that exists within the Maw, no one is quite sure what it eats or why it exists, but they can't get rid of it.

name: Verdant Kit
desc: Raised in the verdant groves of Ardenweald, these kits are infused with the essence of rebirth.

name: Decay Grub
desc: These grubs consume anima-depleted materials of all types. They aren't picky.

name: Starmoth
desc: The wings of this moth glitter like the starry skies above Ardenweald.

name: Backbone
desc: What it lacks in appendages, it makes up for in positive attitude.

name: Vile Deathroach
desc: Every deathroach is technically considered vile, but these really take the cake.

name: Golden Eye
desc: See reflections on the water? There's more than darkness in the depths.

name: Eye of Affliction
desc: These eyes were sent to slow and debilitate the wayward souls of the Maw, so that they could be more easily captured.

name: Bubbling Pustule
desc: The bubbles inside of these ooze creatures make a very satisfying pop noise when they finally surface and rupture.

name: Skittering Venomspitter
desc: If this species spits venom at its prey, is it still technically considered venom, or just really gross?

name: Bloodlouse Larva
desc: What vile subtance is jiggling around inside of this creature?

name: Deepwood Leaper
desc: The latent energy found throughout Ardenweald's seeds sometimes augments small critters with unnatural abilities.

name: Chompy
desc: One of several indistinguishable pets, all named Chompy.

name: Eye of Allseeing
desc: The Eye of the Jailer, diffused, is now merely an all-seeing magical bauble.

name: Eye of Extermination
desc: The rage Zovaal harbored for his punished existence echoes through the eye.

name: Gilded Darknight
desc: The golden armor on these mawsworn is flimsy and easily bent -- the gilded armor is a punishment.

name: Timeless Mechanical Dragonling
desc: Dragons come in all types of temporal classification -- timeless, time-lost, and even infinite.

name: Sly
desc: Sly snuck aboard for a trip into the Maw. He's not scared, he just really wants to stay in your backpack for a while.

name: Animite Broodling
desc: A young animite will rapidly grow if fed in excess. It is suggested that no more than one average soul's worth of anima be consumed per year to keep them docile.

name: Blinky
desc: Blinky just hatched, and is ready for adventure, but may need a few naps along the way.

name: Murkastrasza
desc: Hatch-queen of the baby murlocs, Murkastrasza spent many years battling her bitter rival, Deathy.

name: Mu'dud
desc: The soul that occupies Mu'dud was a harsh ruler in life, and now he seeks to dominate the most violent kingdom of all.

name: Steward Featherling
desc: Stewards looking to move up in steward society know to fluff up their feathers, give out tons of juice, and always be hooting.

name: Lil' Mon
desc: Big Mon was all alone until he found an injured snakebiter. He nursed the snakebiter back to health and named him Lil' Mon. Big Mon may have been undead, but he wasn't heartless. He loved Lil' Mon and would do anything to protect his only friend.

name: Lost Featherling
desc: Tales say that the stewards were created to aid the denizens of Bastion in their eternal duties. They don't seem to mind.

name: Larion Pouncer
desc: Larion are prideful beasts, and see anyone that enters their territory as a challenge.

name: Mawsworn Minion
desc: The Sanctum of Domination accepts mawsworn of all shapes, sizes, and levels of corporeality.

name: Mord'al Eveningstar
desc: A ruthless tormenter of the smallest souls. Some say he was known in life as "Thermaplugg."

name: Rook
desc: Rook never speaks, and little about them is known.

name: Anxious Nibbler
desc: You have never met a pet that is more about chewing.

name: Iridescent Ooze
desc: This slime seems to change color the more you look at it, and then suddenly, it appears to be looking back at you. Perhaps it is time for a rest.

name: Copperback Etherwyrm
desc: The brilliant scales of the etherwyrm reflect the bright skies of Bastion.

name: Ruby Baubleworm
desc: The gemstones on a baubleworm will quickly deteriorate if the worm is killed. Healthy worms are kept as prized pets by wealthy Brokers.

name: Turquoise Baubleworm
desc: Baubleworms were found by the Brokers on an unknown world, and so gorgeous were their gems, that quickly the expedition turned against one another.

name: Tunneling Vombata
desc: Only newly synthesized tunneling vombata have been seen. The rest are probably happily digging underground, never to be seen again.

name: Preyhunter's Riftbreaker
desc: Each step hums with mana; each punch ends the chase.

name: Larion Cub
desc: When fully-grown, a larion that has grown up with an aspirant will never leave his or her master's side.

name: Courage
desc: Young larions are often given to aspirants as an early test of compassion and leadership.

name: Crawbat
desc: For a pet that's all mouth, where does anything it eats go? Maldraxxus necromancers have dissected many of these pets, and have no answers.

name: Archetype of Animation
desc: One part rocks, two parts bigger rocks, three parts smaller rocks, one part ability to move anyway.

name: Young Garnetgullet
desc: The garnetgullet rolls in bright red flowers to enhance its color, serving as a call to similar species and a warning to enemies.

name: Korthian Specimen
desc: With Korthia torn asunder by the Jailer, the few species that remain must be archived.

name: Topaz Baubleworm
desc: Baubleworms have no natural predators, and grow their gemstones to attract mates.

name: Gurgl
desc: New species of murloc are discovered around Azeroth all the time, owing to their invasive nature and varied diet.

name: Archetype of Motion
desc: One part beak, two parts wings, one part inability to stop, one part unwillingness to stop.

name: Mosscoated Gromit
desc: The hide color of this species is more rare on Korthia, and helps it hide from predators. And mawsworn, in this case.

name: Domestic Aunian
desc: A domesticated species, it is quite calm and seems hungry.

name: Curious Purrkin
desc: The Purrkin hunt the invasive skrats in the Veiled Market, keeping the population just high enough that they are still needed.

name: Silver Purrkin
desc: Purrkins are a traditional pet of the Brokers and the two have a mutually beneficial relationship -- a necessity in Broker culture.

name: Devourling
desc: Devourers exist throughout the In-Between of various types and levels of power, but always seeking anima.

name: Gnashtooth
desc: It only has two teeth, and they both mean business.

name: Clutch
desc: That place on your back you can't quite scratch? Get the help of this little guy. Problem solved.

name: Gizmo
desc: Gizmo is considered a perfect purrkin, perhaps the best that has ever existed. He is also a ruthless murderer of small critters.

name: Damp Skrat
desc: Skrats are poisonous, venomous, and unusually damp -- everything you want in a pet.

name: Feasting Larva
desc: Being thrown into a pit of bloodlouse larvae is a painful fate for those that fail the great houses of Maldraxxus.

name: Shy Melvin
desc: One of Plague Deviser Marileth's first creations, Shy Melvin was too timid for the demands placed on slimes by the House of Plagues.

name: Scavenging Skrat
desc: Skrats are an especially invasive species, in that they can reproduce with only a sole skrat, and consume almost anything.

name: Rarity
desc: One particular Broker has taken a liking to the skrat species, kept this rare specimin as a pet, and inherited the smell as a souvenir.

name: Fodder
desc: When you're a Maldraxxian stitchcrafter and you have to name a lot of abominations, sometimes you just go with the obvious choice.

name: Lucy
desc: Lucy was sent to Revendreth, as all cats are, and somehow escaped. When questioned, local dredgers blamed it on her being a cat.

name: Bloodfeaster Spiderling
desc: Unlike most spiders that drain all the fluids from their prey, the bloodfeaster has developed a taste for blood alone.

name: Dredger Butler
desc: Dredgers are the sweat (and sometimes tears) of Revendreth, and their help is absolutely critical to the workings of Revendreth.

name: Archetype of Metamorphosis
desc: One part gills, one part haste, one part whatever it needs to be.

name: Resonant Echo
desc: The core of a song that all but faded long ago.

name: Omnipotential Core
desc: It could become anything. It could become *everything*. In the meantime, it's... this.

name: Geordy
desc: It's hard to be sure since it has no face, but this thing seems to like you.

name: Archetype of Focus
desc: One part focus, one part core, zero parts coherent or stable shape.

name: Char
desc: The skies may have scorched part of Revendreth, but persistent creatures are still able to exist in these harsh conditions.

name: Pulsating Maggot
desc: Normally just a plain white in color, their skin reflects whatever they have eaten and gains wonderful spots of color depending on the organs digested.

name: Drakks
desc: A drakonid hatchling is a curious sight, but now is the time for curious things.

name: Sinheart
desc: Sometimes sins of great souls are so powerful that they animate the very stones they are placed on.

name: Hissing Deathroach
desc: Many have asked where these creatures came from, and how they made it to the Maw, but none that researched them have ever been heard from again.

name: Squibbles
desc: Squibbles is engineered to never leave your side.

name: Flawless Amethyst Baubleworm
desc: Baubleworms are highly prized in the Veiled Market, where those featuring few gemstone flaws can fetch extreme prices.

name: Blushing Spiderling
desc: The crypts and tombs of Revendreth offer the perfect spider breeding ground, and Tomb Burster's brood has become fiercely territorial of their foothold.

name: Lil' Abom
desc: The fields of battle teem with Lil'Abom parts, which are perfectly interchangable and easy to put back together.

name: Infused Etherwyrm
desc: Infused etherwyrms can be used as portable anima batteries, but they must be trained not to flee at the sight of combat.

name: Dusty Sporeflutterer
desc: The moths of Ardenweald can carry seeds and pods many times their own weight, aiding the Night Fae in their eternal tasks.

name: Archetype of Serenity
desc: One part slippery skin, one part powerful legs, one part vocal sac, one part complete self-acceptance.

name: Venomous Bufonid
desc: Some of the more adventurous denizens of Zereth Mortis consider venomous bufonids to be a delicacy.

name: Putrid Geist
desc: Despite being decrepit and undead, geists move with exceptional speed and agility.

name: Carpal
desc: Nobody knows why all of these skeletal hands are from the left hand. Where did the right hands go?

name: Tower Deathroach
desc: Torghast is a tower of hardship and perpetual agony, which is a perfect environment for these creatures.

name: Severs
desc: If a detached hand claps by itself inside of Torghast, can the Jailer hear it?

name: Timid Leporid
desc: Some of the more timid leporids live deep underground. They emerge only to gather food before returning to their burrows.

name: Proto Avian Fledgling
desc: While larger proto avians are known to feed on small animals, fledglings mostly eat insects and grubs.

name: Violet Violence
desc: Some very clever wizard or dragon or other magical being thought they were being clever when they decided to color an ice elemental purple for a very elaborate bit of wordplay. They were probably right.

name: Pricklefury Hare
desc: This is the most pettable pointy creature you will ever meet.

name: Magma Slug
desc: Somehow this creature manages to be hot, rocky, and slimy all at the same time.

name: Shiverweb Broodling
desc: Ironically, she has a warm personality.

name: Moon-Touched Netherwhelp
desc: A strange whelp hatched on Netherwing Ledge, it is thought to be blessed by the waning lunar energies of Shadowmoon Valley.

name: Tarachnid Stalker
desc: Some tarachnids prefer to lie in wait for their prey. These prefer to chase it, disable it, and devour it whole.

name: Archetype of Satisfaction
desc: Two parts wings, one part beak, two parts talon, one part smugness.

name: Shelly
desc: Isn't she just the sweetest little helicid?

name: Ambystan Darter
desc: Ambystans are swift but cowardly creatures. At the first hint of danger, a darter will hide in the nearest hole.

name: Fierce Scarabid
desc: The red coloring on this scarabid lets potential opponents know it is not to be trifled with.

name: Jeweled Onyx Whelpling
desc: The master jewelcrafters of the Dragon Isles have perfected their craft so much that their gemmed statues can be brought to life. This whelp forged of obsidian is now not to be trifled with.

name: Ichabod
desc: Ichabod began his existence as a prototype for the fearsome harvest golems terrorizing the farmers of Westfall, but a little gnomish ingenuity has since made him far less likely to attack your knees.

name: Buttercup
desc: His pink antlers make him the life of any party.

name: Snowy Treeflitter
desc: Nearly invisible, this creature leaps from tree to snow-covered tree.

name: Wakyn
desc: Hope, like this phoenix, rises from the ashes of shattered dreams.

name: Lil' Maka'jin
desc: Looks like Ben'jin and Maka'fon have kept busy since you last saw them. Maka'jin is ready for adventure but will settle for a large pile of leafy greens.

name: Buzzworth
desc: Some species of red bees are known to lead solitary lives. Still, this busy bee seems happy to make time for you.

name: Corrosive Writhling
desc: They're so cute when they're young! You still don't want to touch it...

name: Garrlok
desc: Ancient Gorian blood runs through Garrlok's veins. As far as anyone knows, only his diminutive stature keeps his imperial ambitions in check.

name: Crushhoof
desc: Siege training begins early for kodo calflings that show a lack of inhibition towards breaking things. Mind your shins.

name: Tarachnid Ambusher
desc: When prey wanders into this creature's reach, it rarely wanders out.

name: Archetype of Survival
desc: One part shell. One part claw. As many parts resilience as need be.

name: Snek'zali
desc: Demands scritches and blood sacrifices.

name: Pippin
desc: He has a heart of gold. Literally. These shiny good-boys are all the rage with affluent gnomes everywhere.

name: Ambystan Snapper
desc: The ambystan snapper is one of the nicest creatures you can meet in Zereth Mortis... until it isn't.

name: Aurelid Floater
desc: Most of Zereth Mortis' aurelids are content to swim, but some are born to fly!

name: Enraged Poultrid
desc: Nobody calls this poultrid 'chicken.'

name: Predatory Helicid
desc: When confronted, helicids will hide in their heavily armored shells. If provoked further, they will lash out with devastating force.

name: Gnomelia Gearheart
desc: Spunky, funky, and just a little clunky -- she's a Gnomish engineer to a T!

name: Lightless Tormentor
desc: This tiny tormentor of Torghast relishes in punishing any soul in the tower that can't step on it.

name: Drazka'zet the Wrathful
desc: Fooled aeons ago by the clever loa of death into a bargain of unceasing service, this tiny ancient being carries out his duties eternally red with rage.

name: Archetype of Malice
desc: Two parts wings, one part dagger, five parts sadism.

name: Momma Vombata
desc: There are many terrifying things in Zereth Mortis, but none so terrifying (or adorable) as a vombata protecting its young.

name: Lil' Ursoc
desc: Before he was known as one of the Wild Gods, Ursoc roamed the Grizzly Hills as a cub.

name: Egbob
desc: Some hawkstriders are destined to be great. Others are destined to be Egbob.

name: Watcher of the Huntress
desc: To its foes, this Watcher's innocent eyes belie the lethal danger of a prowling Huntress, waiting in the shadows.

name: Spyragos
desc: This little dragon is all fired up! It looks like he's got some things to do.

name: Emmah
desc: Is it normal for a fish to have fangs?

name: Patos
desc: This frillfish is a no-frills kind of frillfish.

name: Kindlet
desc: A troublesome mage named McGwire decided to start a small fire. He summoned a flame which caused him to exclaim: 'This is much more alive than required!'

name: Treeflitter
desc: Many have tried to boop the cute little noses of creatures like this. Most have lost fingers.

name: Amber Treeflitter
desc: The forests of Eversong have enjoyed a recent influx of these flying critters.

name: Pistachio
desc: Pistachio got her name in exactly the way you would expect.

name: Bronze Racing Enthusiast
desc: This little racing enthusiast has never missed a race and has never met a racer she didn't like.

name: Shyfly
desc: These elusive creatures are famous for being hard to find unless you already know where to look. Fortunately, Haniko told you where to look.

name: Jeweled Sapphire Whelpling
desc: Sometimes you can see blue light flickering deep inside the gems that make up this strange creature.

name: Berylmane
desc: The vorquin of the dragon isles have manes that come in a variety of stunning colors.

name: Time-Lost Vorquin Foal
desc: It's quite possible this creature is aging backwards. It looks a bit younger every time you see it.

name: Violent Poultrid
desc: These poultrids are hostile, but never angry. They love every moment of every battle.

name: Multichicken
desc: It's really unclear what's 'multi' about them.

name: Stabilized Geomental
desc: Lihuvim's geomental creations are the most majestic of walking rock piles.

name: Shaggy
desc: This little rabbit is cute from the tip of her button nose to the tips of her deadly claws.

name: Cubbly
desc: Cubbly's extended proximity to time magic has given him powers far beyond the average bear.

name: Jeweled Amber Whelpling
desc: The hardest part to shape was the whelpling's cute little snout.

name: Jeweled Ruby Whelpling
desc: Trade Prince Gallywix wants you to know that he already owns three of these.

name: Driftling
desc: This creature is usually known to be quite docile, but try to stick a carrot in its face and YOU WILL lose feeling in your fingers.

name: Vortex
desc: Arrogant from a past life in the stormy Forbidden Reach, pines after the good old days when the elements controlled the land. Bit of a blow hard really.

name: Tremblor
desc: Claims to be from a long lost land from the remnants of a massive volcano, but that story seems a little shaky.

name: Wildfire
desc: The flames surrounding it burn more intensely during combat. Could even say that pet battles get it stoked.

name: Flow
desc: Perks its head up when hearing conversation as it likes to stay current on world affairs.

name: Archetype of Cunning
desc: Three parts planning, one part danger, one part noodle.

name: Red Viperid
desc: The distinctive red coloration of these viperids serves as a warning to potential predators: 'eat at your own risk!'

name: King Viperid
desc: Where does a 350-pound viperid sit? Anywhere it wants.

name: Green Viperid
desc: Viperids can sit still for hours, silently awaiting their prey.

name: Jeweled Emerald Whelpling
desc: A magically infused emerald sits at the heart of this creature.

name: Primal Stormling
desc: Raindrops whip around this creature with frightening speed, ripping and tearing anything that touches it. Experts say the best way to avoid injury is to give it a treat and some snuggles.

name: Pocopoc
desc: This isn't the real Pocopoc, but it provided this replica to you for use outside Zereth Mortis. Its details are so accurate as to be utterly convincing to anyone who hasn't spent lots of time with the real one.

name: Vombata Pup
desc: Despite its vulnerable appearance, predators will often avoid attacking a juvenile vombata. It's not known exactly why, but many believe it has to do with the vombata's cute little nose.

name: Azure Frillfish
desc: Oddly enough, you met this fish drifting through the air.

name: Lord Basilton
desc: A brilliant executive assistant and apprentice, Lord Basilton also loves to stick his nose into piles of anything interesting.

name: Helpful Workshop Bot
desc: The name 'Beepbop' followed by the words 'Made by Threadis' are roughly but lovingly scratched into the bottom plate on this tiny nerubian-crafted bot.

name: Lady Feathersworth
desc: Though she may be fashionably late, Lady Feathersworth will always show up for a party.

name: Black Slyvern Pup
desc: Above the vast green plains and rolling hills the slyvern fly, leaving only tiny shadows on the ground to mark their path through the sky.

name: Troubled Tome
desc: Do you dare to open this book of draconic secrets?

name: Pinkie
desc: With her distinctive coloration and impeccable work ethic, Pinkie has propelled herself to the top of the tallstrider fashion world.

name: Metallic Scarabid
desc: Some of the smaller scarabids of Zereth Mortis have metallic outer shells to protect themselves. It also makes them look fabulous.

name: Bloodsucker Vespoid
desc: Whether in life or the afterlife, some things are universal. Nasty blood-sucking insects are one of those things.

name: Snowclaw Cub
desc: An adult Snowclaw can rattle the very trees with its roar. A cub can rattle one of the smaller branches.

name: Bugbiter Tortoise
desc: This turtle eats bugs, as you'd expect from its name, but you wouldn't believe how large the bugs are.

name: Diamond Crab
desc: Exposure to magic, minerals, and water pressure has left this crab looking very sharp.

name: Sapphire Crab
desc: These crabs build their own shells from small fragments of rocks and gems.

name: Striped Snakebiter
desc: These creatures were bred to hunt snakes. With a low profile and a long body, Snakebiters are perfect for chasing serpents into their own holes.

name: Roseate Hopper
desc: Most brightly colored frogs are incredibly poisonous. The Roseate Hoppers are different because they are only credibly poisonous.

name: E'rnee
desc: A little ambystan that was too big, then too little, and finally just right. He followed you home!

name: Blackfeather Nester
desc: There is no fury quite like that of a mother Blackfeather defending her nest.

name: Magic Nibbler
desc: It's tried to cut down, but magic is just so tasty.

name: Crimson Proto-Whelp
desc: This proto-whelp's distinctive coloration is highly prized by pet trainers.

name: Black Skitterbug
desc: After pestering the Dragonscale Basecamp for weeks, Granpap Whiskers discovered a way to catch them and use them to get rid of other more annoying insects.

name: Gray Marmoni
desc: Under the invitation and tutelage of Doc Nanners many Gray Marmoni have become common, but not always desired guests at the Dragonscale Expedition Basecamp.

name: Phoenix Wishwing
desc: Some think this creature is smoldering because it is on fire. In truth it's because of its burning gaze.

name: Ashenwing
desc: Red for the fires in which it was born.

name: Gerald
desc: Is it possible to rise from the ashes of time? Gerald thinks so and he will not be denied.

name: Igneoid
desc: An Igneoid is formed when magma makes it to Azeroth's surface and is infused with dark elemental magic. The resulting creature is tiny, fierce, and very cute.

name: Palamanther
desc: This salamanther wants to be your best friend.

name: Time-Lost Salamanther
desc: This Salamanther met itself while lost in time. The two hung out on a rock together for a few hours. It was nice.

name: Echo of the Depths
desc: What the deep claims, none can reclaim.

name: Ironbeak Duck
desc: Though many creatures of the Dragon Isles are mysterious, the ducks are perhaps the most so. Where did they come from? Where are they going? What are they planning? We may never know.

name: Wild Duckling
desc: Quack.

name: Pilot
desc: Still learning how to fly.

name: Archetype of Renewal
desc: Just one part jelly, but refreshed over and over and over again.

name: Terror Jelly
desc: It feeds on fear, but is generally too cute to inspire terror on its own.

name: Prototickles
desc: This creature's existence strongly implies the existence of other, more advanced tickle-based aurelids out there.

name: Leaping Leporid
desc: Left to their own devices, these leporids will leap high into the air at the slightest provocation. Sometimes they'll even come down properly, as well.

name: Archetype of Vigilance
desc: Two parts fortress, one part eyestalks, one part slime.

name: Viperid Menace
desc: Where some viperids lie in wait for their prey, this variety stalks their intended meals for hours.

name: Microlicid
desc: Since synthesized creatures come into being fully grown, why would anyone design an immature helicid?

name: Archetype of Predation
desc: Eight parts legs. Eight parts eyes. One part rope. One part insatiable hunger.

name: Emerald Scarabid
desc: This scarabid's brightly colored shell makes it more interesting to potential mates. Unfortunately, this also makes them interesting to potential predators.

name: Living Mud Mask
desc: The greatest souvenir available in a dragon's spa in the clouds. Not so good at facials any more, though.

name: Mallard Duckling
desc: What do you feed a cute little duckling? What? No, not cheese and quackers! Quackers aren't healthy for ducks.

name: Quack-E
desc: Beep. Beep. Beep. Quack.

name: Plucky Duckling
desc: This is the terror that flaps o'er the Dragon Isles. This is the winged nightmare that pecks at your emerald dreams. What? No it's not Deathwing, it's a duck!

name: Viridescent Duck
desc: These beautiful, elusive birds have very erratic migratory patterns, which can be difficult to track, leading some explorers to erroneously believe ducks simply didn't exist.

name: Echo of the Heights
desc: In the mountain air, frost lingers upon the grass as a storm rolls in.

name: Ohuna Companion
desc: Its eyes can see the flick of a mouse tail from leagues away.

name: Grassland Stomper
desc: Each of this creature's steps shakes the ground. When enough of them run together it sounds like a raging thunderstorm.

name: Lubbins
desc: Who's the cutest little monster? You are!

name: Hoofhelper
desc: Though it's rare, thunder lizards have been known to bond with centaurs. And their close allies. Lucky you!

name: Thunderfoot Calf
desc: When these creatures stampede, they sound like a thunderstorm. When these creatures stampede in a thunderstorm, they sound like a cataclysm.

name: Blue Dasher
desc: The bad news is that these bugs are carnivorous. The good news is that they usually just eat other bugs.

name: Polliswog
desc: These critters often leave their spawning groups as soon as they can move around on land.

name: Yipper
desc: Soon after you put down this slyvern's decay-twisted mother, you learned the hard way both how it got its name and why Zon'Wogi asked you to care for it.

name: Whitewhisker
desc: These critters' white coats help them hide in the snow when  predators are around.

name: Scout
desc: Scout came to the Dragon Isles for adventure and excitement. After finding you, he got both.

name: Petal
desc: When the Bushbeard clan decided they were going to have a wedding, they chose Petal to be the flower girl. She was spectacular.

name: Alvin the Anvil
desc: When Alvin said he wanted to be the best anvil ever, everyone doubted him. If anvils could laugh, he'd be the one laughing now.

name: Chestnut
desc: Chestnut once found an acorn larger than he was, ate the whole thing, and doubled in size. It's a good thing he didn't eat a Trunkalumpf.

name: Grizzlefur Cub
desc: These small bears will not normally attack people, but they have been known to steal the occasional picnic basket.

name: Razortooth Bear Cub
desc: It's not easy having red fur during the winter, but in the autumn it's very fashionable.

name: Stoneshell
desc: These creatures' shells are not literally made of stone, but they're strong enough that they might as well be.

name: Storm-Touched Ottuk
desc: A playful splash from this otter will give you quite a shock.

name: Woodbiter Piculet
desc: These birds use their sharp beaks and dragon-like talons to forage for prey on tree trunks and branches. They communicate with each other by drumming on the trees with their beaks, which makes a sound that can be heard over great distances.

name: Brightfeather
desc: It has bright feathers. What else is there to say?

name: Secretive Frogduck
desc: It looks like a duck and it smells like a duck and it quacks like a duck... what's a duck?

name: Crystalline Mini-Monster
desc: A shard of a fragment of a piece of a sliver of a piece of crystal, but walking around like it owns the place. Good thing it likes you.

name: Mister Muskoxeles
desc: Truly, the most dignified of stinky musken.

name: Emberling
desc: The core temperature of an Emberling is hot enough to dissolve anything organic, so make sure to wear gloves if you want to pet it.

name: Chip
desc: Born of living stone. Reforged by the hands of Wrathion's agents. Sadly much too tiny to make a difference in the black dragons' war against the djaradin.

name: Mister Toots
desc: His name is Mister Toots because of the melodious sounds he can make with his trunk.

name: Ghostflame
desc: A dream of the memory of fire.

name: Trunkalumpf
desc: While their tiny tusks may not help much in a fight, the trunkalumpfs make up for it in sheer weight.

name: Echo of the Inferno
desc: A spark can become an ember. An ember can become a raging fire. This creature was never a spark or an ember, it has only ever been a raging fire.

name: Bunbo
desc: It sits anywhere it wants to, but it prefers to sit on laps.

name: Scruffles
desc: Scruffles' lust for battle runs deep.

name: Pale Baby Vorquin
desc: Behold! A pale vorquin.

name: Bakar Companion
desc: Faithful and ferocious, this bakar is a hero's best friend.

name: Gilded Mechafrog
desc: An old and dangerous discarded toy.

name: Backswimmer Timbertooth
desc: When not lazily floating down a river, this Timbertooth is fond of snacks and snuggles.

name: Jean's Lucky Fish
desc: To some, this fish speaks eloquently of its survival in the most arduous conditions. To most, it says 'glub.'

name: Vorquin Runt
desc: It will probably grow bigger. Probably.

name: Kobaldt
desc: Sharp crystal needles protrude from this creature's back, and yet it still wants you to pet it somehow.

name: Echo of the Cave
desc: Formed by the reckless use of elemental magic, the slumbering earth awakens. It is angry.

name: Chalkshell Turtle
desc: Despite its name, its shell is actually much tougher than chalk.

name: Azure Crystalspine
desc: These creatures are highly sought after by hunters looking to make weapons from the sharp crystals on its back.

name: Crimsonspine
desc: The blood of a crimsonspine flows through the clear crystal structures that make up its body, which causes its unique coloration.

name: Dusky Timbertooth
desc: Hunters value these critters more for their companionship than their pelts.

name: Tiny Timbertooth
desc: As good as gold and better. These little guys are quite frail but exceedingly brave. - Bob Bigheart

name: Mawtouched Geomental
desc: No one in their right mind has ever seen a Mawtouched Geomental. Even so, plenty of people have seen Mawtouched Geomentals.

name: Storm-Touched Timbertooth
desc: A timbertooth with lighting inside? Shocking!

name: Buckie
desc: Gnawing at the roots of magic trees have given this creature the ability to transcend time itself.

name: Obsidian Proto-Whelp
desc: After finding a clutch of black proto-whelps, Wrathion took them under his wing.

name: Scruffy Ottuk
desc: Between battling, bathing, and playing, these ottuks have very busy schedules.

name: Swoglet
desc: The reverberating sound of an adult hornswog's belch can be heard for leagues. Less far-reaching, but far more musical, is the dainty sound of a swoglet belching.

name: Snowlemental
desc: When you feel a chill run down your spine, don't be afraid. It's probably just your pet snowlemental.

name: Whiskuk
desc: Baby ottuks spend their days swimming, chasing butterflies, and practicing their intimidating roars.

name: Luvvy
desc: In its big eyes you can see your own reflection. You also see everything else because its eyes are so big.

name: Arfus
desc: There must always be a Lick King.

name: Puddlehopper
desc: Puddlehoppers are known to eat bugs almost as large as they are. In one gulp!

name: Rock Martin
desc: Rock martins make their nests out of scavenged pebbles.

name: Yellabon
desc: When these insects move in a swarm they look like a golden fog.

name: Endmite
desc: This creature usually has a muddy appearance, but occasionally you may find one that shines a brilliant red.

name: Roggy
desc: Roggy is the kind of snail that never gives up, no matter how hard things get.

name: Rango
desc: If bananas grew in caves, they would be Rango's favorite food.

name: Miloh
desc: Miloh likes naps. Also snacks.

name: Blaise
desc: Like a campfire, but it wants skritches.

name: Ambre
desc: Nothing sparked joy in Ambre's heart until it found the perfect match.

name: Ysergle
desc: Also known as the Dreamurk, Ysergle slumbered for many long years in the Emrgrled Dream.

name: Stonewhisker
desc: The bright glow of a stonewhisker's ears is said to be the result of eating magical cheeses. This may also explain its extremely bad breath.

name: Cobbleshell
desc: Slimy, yet also gritty. It would not make a good meal.

name: Boulderfang
desc: Boulderfangs are known to make cozy nests in cabinets, shoes, and other inconvenient places.

name: Crimson Swoglet
desc: Crimson swoglets are considered the most scholarly of all swoglets because they're well red.

name: Bronze Swoglet
desc: Three years ago this swoglet was a fully grown adult.

name: Rusty
desc: Rusty's powerful nose could smell a needle in a haystack.

name: Amador
desc: Amador has a big heart and loves to help people, especially children and elders. He also likes belly rubs.

name: Brul
desc: Sure it's just a rock, but how much can it lift?

name: Volatile Self-Driving Toolbox
desc: Who needs a toolbelt when a handy robot can follow you around! Just don't bump into it too hard.

name: Azure Swoglet
desc: Other frogs like to play, but this one is feeling too blue.

name: Slabwing
desc: Despite being made mostly of rock, these creatures can fly. Some attribute this to the strength of their wings, but most agree it's probably just magic.

name: Hollow Moth
desc: Not all moths spin silk. These moths spin lies.

name: Sunglow Cobra
desc: A tiny sun seems to burn in its chest.

name: Lettuce
desc: Cave swallows were once plentiful in the early days of Undermine's construction. Now, goblin construction has left the population of these beautiful birds dangerously low.

name: Byrn
desc: Its insides are a raging inferno. Its outside is happy pup.

name: Jade Skitterbug
desc: Imagine the size of the birds that eat these bugs.

name: Jerrie
desc: Jerrie was once an ordinary rock mouse. He still is, in fact.

name: Diamondshell
desc: These snails are especially prized by many drogbar snail-racers for being fast and looking fantastic.

name: Ravenous Shalewing
desc: This creature can eat twice its bodyweight at a single meal.

name: Emerald Swoglet
desc: Being green is... not easy.

name: Annuna
desc: Annuna's distinctive coloration is due to her eating nothing but orange dragonflies.

name: Blub
desc: Blub's heart has always been bigger than her tank, but once the rest of her got too big she had to find a new home. Fortunately, she can now travel with you and see all the marvels of the world!

name: Ebonwing Moth
desc: Because they are often attracted to candles, these moths can be a big problem for kobolds.

name: Roland
desc:
If Roland has taught you anything, it's that friendship comes at a price.

That price is lots and lots of cheese.

name: Iggy
desc: Solid and dependable, Iggy is always ready for a fierce battle or a gentle metaphor.

name: Lord Stantley
desc: Lord Stantley will arrive fashionably early to any party that serves shrimp.

name: Savage Lobstrok
desc: It's not really all that savage, just a little crabby.

name: Cheddar
desc: It got its name because its favorite food is fondue.

name: Bashful
desc: While not as fast as some of the other snails in the Zaralek Cavern, Bashful makes up for it with sheer power.

name: Thimblerig
desc: Known to hide money in its shell.

name: Tricky
desc: Layers of rocky skin make Ambershells very tough to hurt.

name: Lithengale
desc: The call of the lithengale is unique among birds in that it has a persistent, driving rhythm.

name: Scarlapod
desc: Because their dens tend to be close to drogbar settlements, these snails are both faster and stronger than those on the surface.

name: Deepridger
desc: The fire at the center of the world burns within its carapace.

name: Devourer Lobstrok
desc: Fortunately it mainly devours pet treats.

name: Abyssal Lurker
desc: A warlock won this little guy at an infernal carnival, but it quickly outgrew its aquarium.

name: Three-Eyed Fish
desc: Like Neltharion, this fish went mad listening to whispers of the Old Cods.

name: Void Lurker
desc: How exactly does one swim through a void? This creature knows, but isn't telling.

name: Paulie
desc: This type of beetle feeds on dragon scales. Its bright coloration warns predators against attack.

name: Roseshell
desc: Roseshells are known to be very agressive, but aren't very fast. So if you mess with one, prepare to be bitten in about five seconds.

name: Brulee
desc: Somehow pretty and gross at the same time.

name: Ridged Shalewing
desc: For a creature made of rocks it hovers quite effortlessly.

name: Soot-Stained Shalewing
desc: These pests are known for their cantankerous attitudes and affinity for nesting in the smokestacks of Undermine, much to the locals dismay.

name: Whoopy
desc: Delivers the goods while also looking good.

name: Lil' Manny
desc: As master of all the ball pit lords, Manny rules over playgrounds with a spirit filled with fun and mischievousness.

name: Remembered Riverpaw
desc: Once tenacious and terrible, the riverpaw slaughtered weaker enemies without hesitation.

name: Voidcrawler
desc: Formented in the chaos and dust of Voidstorm. It hasn't even learned how to hate yet!

name: Mossy Snail
desc: Imagine being so slow moving that moss grows on your back. Couldn't be me.

name: Marrlok
desc: Ancient Gorian blood runs through Marrlok's veins. As far as anyone knows, his desire to rest for long stretches of time on a sunny beach keeps his imperial ambitions in check.

name: Trishi
desc: She sees you when you're sleeping.

name: Worgli the Apprehensive
desc: Maybe give up! Maybe surrender!

name: Vile Bloodtick
desc: Sweet is the black blood. It tastes of wars past, and wars to come.

name: Frenzied Bloodtick
desc: Most people don't find congealed blood particularly appetizing. Bloodticks, though...

name: Tidal Kroling
desc: These small krolusks seem to prefer the sandy shoals and high humidity of the isles' many beaches.

name: Wanderer Liu
desc: Like most young meeksi, Liu has a penchant for finding both trouble and adventure. Unlike other meeksi, Liu can teleport across great distances in search of both.

name: Cinderwold Sizzlestinger
desc: Now that is one spicy bee!

name: Pinkskin Burrower
desc: So wrinkly!! So scrunchy!!

name: Happy
desc: It doesn't seem to know where it is, but it's happy to be here!

name: Timbered Sky Snakelet
desc: It is almost as if a wooden toy has come to life. Keep this pet away from children.

name: Razeshi B.
desc: Razeshi B. is known for her short temper, quick wit and sharp barbs. The B. stands for "Best check yourself."

name: Claudius
desc: Claudius is known for being brutally honest as well as a great singer. He knows your jewels would look better on him.

name: Belastrasza
desc: Bela has learned some humility since you first met her, so she likely won't boss you around too much.

name: Tock the Clocker Spaniel
desc: Tock the Clocker Spaniel is one of the best watch dogs you can ask for.

name: Remembered Construct
desc: Made from the bits and pieces of vanquished abominations, light magic, and just a pinch of nostalgia.

name: Remembered Spawn
desc: The faded memory of an Onyxian whelpling, this young dragon has decided that it wants to follow in its own footsteps.

name: Princess Vorquistrasza
desc: Princess Vorquistrasza wants you to know that she appreciates you coming to her birthday party, but is underwhelmed by your gift.

name: Zhusadormu
desc: Now that he's no longer sneezing through time, Zhusa is ready to accompany you on your future adventures! Or past adventures! Or future adventures!

name: Zalethgos
desc: Zaleth is looking forward to accompanying you on your adventures. He's already got a list of books he wants to take with him, but Lasztak said he could only bring 2.

name: Pallibrius
desc: Pallibrius is an amazing book because of its wealth of arcane knowledge. Also because of all the pie recipes its previous owner scribbled in the margins.

name: Posidriss
desc: Posidriss is excited to go on adventures with you, but maybe let them have a nap first?

name: Somnius
desc: Somnius is legendary for her ability to sleep through everything except suppertime.

name: Marmaduke
desc: Though left behind on the Siren Isle, this old but very good boy proves that some things only get better with age.

name: Craboom
desc: Small, snappy, and with a temper as explosive as its name. Handle with caution!

name: Rak-Ush Threadling
desc: Awww, aren't her pedipalps adorable?

name: Arachnoid Hatchling
desc: Many arachnids are left to fend for themselves after hatching. It's a common topic in spider therapy.

name: Chitin Burrower
desc: Tough burrowing claws make it easy for arachnids to get around subterranean areas. But it's a boring life.

name: Argos
desc: The Imperial Lynx is known for being stubborn and moody, but fiercely loyal to those they form bonds with.

name: Skippy
desc: Watch Skippy swim, and then watch him run. The perfect amphibian. Sorry, frogs.

name: Wriggle
desc: The wily fish has never been caught at the end of an angler's hook. He was caught a completely different way.

name: Waddles
desc: Waddles was rejected by the other cave skippers and fell through the cracks, literally, all the way down to Harandar. He's known to follow around people he finds.

name: Moss Skipper
desc: Finally caught a blind cave skipper. He flopped helplessly for twenty minutes and then let out a burp. Great companion he is!

name: Winged Arachnoid
desc: It's a bird! It's a gyrocopter! No wait, it's something way worse. Run.

name: Venomwing
desc: It's not the most original anti-hero name. But it promises to be a compelling crossover.

name: Sceaduthax
desc: This dark-shelled monster thrives in shadows. It's where he does all his best thinking.

name: Pillarnest Bonedrinker
desc: Is it possible to drink bones? Not without a positive mental attitude it's not!

name: Fallowspark Glowfly
desc: The green glow of this firefly is seen as an ill-omen for those who travel in darkness.

name: Azure Flickerfly
desc: The flickering of these lightbugs is said to bring an unnatural and eerie calm to travelers and predators alike.

name: Vibrant Glowfly
desc: Though their light is sometimes mistaken for the glow of toxic substances or dark magic, nerubians and Arathi alike find these insects hauntingly beautiful.

name: Waxwick
desc: In a miracle of dreams and wishes, Waxwick awoke and climbed off a kobold's head to pursue her own path.

name: Magmashell Crawler
desc: Not to be kept indoors if you live in a wooden house.

name: Burntram
desc: Look out! He's comin' right for us! Gradually!

name: Devouring Runt
desc: Hungry? Try eating your foes!

name: Shalewing Devourer
desc: It doesn't even bother to chew its food.

name: Salverun
desc: Perhaps you'd like to see how snakelike it can be!

name: Skaarn
desc: Skaarn likes to coil up inside of your backpack.

name: Fathom Incher
desc: In the depths of the Endless Sea, strange thalassic horrors lurk. Not this fella, though. He's completely normal.

name: Starkstripe Hopper
desc: Brightly colored means do not touch. Red is nature's warning light!

name: Oop'lajax
desc: He's a little jumpy... especially around the face.

name: Aubergine Scootlefish
desc: Not a squid, nor a kid, the scootlefish prefers to keep its ink to itself except under dire circumstances.

name: Verdant Scootlefish
desc: Cute at this size, the humble scootlefish poses a real threat to ships when it grows larger.

name: Shadowy Oozeling
desc: The perfect pet if you love stepping on something wet in the middle of the night.

name: Jade Cragviper
desc: The Jade Cragviper's favorite food is broccoli. Actually, sorry. I just made that up.

name: Aquapo
desc: The fury of the sea in the packge of a puddle.

name: Heartseeker Moth
desc: Whereas some moths are attracted to light, this particular moth seems attracted to warm, fuzzy feelings. Some say the phrase "butterflies in your stomach" actually refers to an infestation of Heartseeker Moths.

name: Fathom
desc: Weighed down by all the loot he has plundered. He could share the burden he carries but it turns out he's a little shellfish.

name: Voidling Ooze
desc: If you hold this up to your ear, you can hear whispers of the Old Gods. Just like a seashell!

name: Writhing Transmutagen
desc: The early worms get the bird.

name: Undermoth
desc: Undermoths are known to be some of the most intelligent moths on Azeroth. This is not saying much.

name: Teardrop Moth
desc: Contrary to their name, these moths are actually quite happy.

name: Rithro
desc: While napping in shrubbery, sometimes his snaggletooth gets caught on a leaf.

name: Astral Emperor's Serpentling
desc: It is said that the Astral Emperor wove these creatures from the stuff of the stars themselves. It is also said that he used only the cutest star-stuff.

name: Muskpaw Calf
desc: This little yak is far snugglier than most of it's kin. And slightly less smelly!

name: Weechi
desc: Weechi adores attention and what better way to get attention than wearing a costume? Simply seek out a Pet Grooming Station, near any Trading Post, to customize this sweet, wonderous little buddy.

name: Lil' Wrathion
desc: Tell them that I am free of my father's madness, and I will be free of them as well. I am to be left alone: this will be my first and only warning. - Wrathion

name: Nelthara
desc: Augmented by Adamanthia's Ebon Might, this whelpling is ready to face any challenge.

name: Senega
desc: Senega is always ready for a ley crystal snack.

name: Axel
desc: Axel likes to chase bees. No one knows why.

name: Fragrant Stonelamb
desc: Protosheep spend winters bereft their flowers. When the seasons turn, the plains are filled with a variety of earthy, sweet scents.

name: Fyrn
desc: Fyrn will be the first one to show up at your birthday party and the last to leaf.

name: Hallowed Glowfly
desc: This hallowed firefly's glow scours the darkness, a welcome omen for the Arathi living in Hallowfall.

name: Bop
desc: Woah there pardner. Were you really about to buzz by without saying howdy?

name: Shadowbog Hopper
desc: Restoring hope to those lost in the darkness comes with its just rewards. Like cute frog friends.

name: Kromos
desc: Kromos can often be found napping in sandboxes.

name: Sandstone Mosswool
desc: These lambs savor a journey to the beaches of Khaz Algar to rest in warm sands.

name: Lil' Moss Rosy
desc: Counting sheep to a dream of springtime.

name: Soulcoil Remnant
desc: Even a failed ritual can leave something behind.

name: Spinner
desc: She'll try spinning, that's a good trick.

name: Anub'Rekyute
desc: He hears little hearts melting. Faster now!

name: Webbers
desc: Web ball! Stone of reality! Web ball! Stone of reality!

name: Itchbite
desc: A bug? Wait a minute, no, it's a small friendly spider!

name: Shale Mosswool
desc: Expert Earthen florists are capable of arranging beautiful floral patterns upon the backs of protosheep.

name: Brown Leafbug
desc: When you tell a bad joke, he'll be there to let you know.

name: Skittish Sniffler
desc: Capable of sensing vibrations and tremors nearly a mile away, these young moles tend to burrow at the first sign of mortal danger.

name: Snuffling
desc: Even hard sediment poses little challenge to the digging claws of these critters.

name: Sneef
desc: She's got a schnoz for sniffin'!

name: Guacamole
desc: This snuffling loves limes.

name: Cinderhoney Emberstinger
desc: THE BEES ARE ON FIRE NOW?

name: Loamy
desc: The softest and fluffiest protosheep made of the softest and fluffiest soil.

name: Meek Bloodlasher
desc: Fungal lashers are typically violent and carnivorous. This diminuative variety is better suited to shyly flail its limbs against fellow small fry.

name: Nightfarm Growthling
desc: These highly destructive pests are known to destroy crops in Hallowfall.

name: Ghostcap Menace
desc: The alluring twin mushroom cap colors of these fungal creatures attracts sentient and beastial victims alike.

name: Scourge of the Aspects
desc: The Scourge of the Aspects is consumed by rage and filled with a hunger to consume. Its presense is a sign of an unpredictable and erratic future for any form of dragonkin.

name: Bouncer
desc: Awww, aren't it's fuzzy little pedipalps cute?

name: Fuzzy
desc: The next time you're sitting in the dark and feel something brush against your heel, don't worry! It's just Fuzzy.

name: Jump Jump
desc: I jump, Jon. It's what I do.

name: Fringe
desc: Someone once mistook Fringe for an azerite node. He's too young to remember azerite, though.

name: Blightbud
desc: Please keep your blightbud on a leash at all times! They are notorious for the havoc they can wreak on unprotected gardens.

name: Chester
desc: Part lean, mean candle-throwing machine. Part adventurer wannabe. All kobold.

name: Cobalt Ramolith
desc: The grand horns of these beasts spark jealousy in other horned grazing animals.

name: Granite Ramolith
desc: Earthen ranchers keep a variety of horned beasts for labor and company. None are so proud as the ramolith.

name: Alabaster Stonecharger
desc: Protorams leave behind stony dust as they frolic, battle, and rest.

name: Teatuft Tamer
desc: The meeksi Teatuft Tamers love lounging with their Teatufts and sipping a cup of mystical tea after a long lazy day.

name: Fullbelly Rollingpaw
desc: The Fullbelly meeksi will often put their own safety at risk if they smell food. Nothing brings them happiness like a cup of tea and a warm meal.

name: Dreamborne Scarab
desc: Compared to a fully grown dreamborne scarab, this is the lesser of two weevils.

name: Dreamhoof
desc: Be sure to sleep with some grass under your pillow so you can give this critter a snack while you dream.

name: Bedrock Stonecharger
desc: Young protorams love to play and bluff charge. They also love to actually charge.

name: Thrrrdgl
desc: Thrrrdgl is content with not being a top choice or even a second choice.  Thrrrdgl believes that first and second are the worst and third is the best.

name: Mister Mans
desc: Given his boisterous behavior, we can only assume that he became imbued with the void from starting a fight. The question remains; who won?

name: Dream Badger
desc: A brown dream badger is a rare sight. Not so rare a smell though.

name: Snoots
desc: Snoots has a supernatural sense of smell. It's not any better than normal, it's just supernatural.

name: Ivy
desc: Since you rescued her from Larodar, this grateful little doe hasn't stopped following you around.

name: Memorie
desc: It is said that some animals dream in black and white. This animal only dreams in green.

name: Elmer
desc: Elmer once ate a whole cake all by himself. It wasn't even his cake.

name: Spruce
desc: What Spruce lacks in speed, she makes up for with sheer stubbornness.

name: Lil' Frostwing
desc: Feel the chill nipping at your toes! A menace of Azeroth, now in festive blue and travel-size!

name: Napps
desc: This creature could sleep through another Cataclysm.

name: Juniper
desc: Juniper's unique coloration makes it hard to hide from predators in the Emerald Dream's lush green foliage. She therefore made the wise decision to travel with you instead.

name: Misty
desc: There are many creatures lurking in the Cape of Stranglethorn who would be glad to kill you. Misty is just curious to see the rest of the world.

name: Snoozles
desc: Snoozles was once given a choice between life in the timeless beautiful snowfields and life in a warm home with pet treats. We know which one he chose.

name: Sarge
desc: When he's not hanging out with Harth Stonebrew or winning competitions at the tavern, Sarge loves to stow away in the backpacks of visiting adventurers.

name: Arathi Chicken
desc: These silkie chickens were taken aboard airships by those departing the Arathi Empire in pursuit of their emperor's prophetic vision.

name: Craggles
desc: This boarlet escaped Coldridge Valley in search of adventure and maybe a nice apple if she can find one.

name: Living Rose
desc: When being adored, a Living Rose emits beautifully intoxicating aromas. When ignored, those aromas become actually toxic.

name: Greenlands Chicken
desc: Free-range chickens are difficult to take care of in Hallowfall, what with all the shadow monsters and fish people.

name: Thunder
desc: Someday, his heavy footfalls and ferocious roar will match his name. Until then, Thunder remains a bolt of cuteness and loyalty.

name: Tiberius
desc: The Imperial Lynx hails from the shore of the far-flung Arathi Empire, where they serve as fierce and loyal companions and mounts for citizens.

name: Bean
desc: The toes! The huge toe beans! The huge toe beans are not for eating!

name: Vanilla
desc: This treasured lynx is a firm supporter of no changes.

name: Eye of Chaos
desc: For so many years Mathias Shaw had his eyes and ears gathering intelligence around Azeroth. Now at least some eyes have come home.

name: Void-Scarred Parrot
desc: Stormwind's Trade District sees many goods and animals pass through its auction house. Once the parrots of Stranglethorn were an expensive luxury. Now those present when N'zoth took over are a scourge.

name: Battleboar Piglet
desc: Rigorously trained from birth these young boars eat, fight and sleep in their armor.

name: Mech-Friend Maya
desc: Meet your new best mech-friend, Maya. Maya loves a good, tight wind-up so she can spring into action.

name: Hopeflutter
desc: Wherever it goes, it leaves behind a soft glow that stirs hope in even the darkest places

name: Merriment
desc: This thing is equally as evil as it is adorable.

name: Swiftpaw
desc: Cub of Blazeclaw and valiant courier of Flame's Radiance. Swiftpaw serves the Sacred Flame more ferociously than some Arathi do.

name: Void-Scarred Scorpid
desc: A creature prized by rogues for its venom. Many lived in the many holes and warrens of the Drag, but after the fall these new horrors emerged to menace the survivors.

name: Void-Scarred Tallstrider Chick
desc: Rarely raised in captivity, Tallstrider's are extremely territorial. A small clutch of eggs was found during a hunt, and a tauren trainer came to Orgrimmar to show them off. However, after the fall, they have become deadly once more. So far, no one has been able to direct their corrupted forms.

name: Rusty Kroling
desc: Once protected by the thick forests of the isle, these smaller and less aggressive krolusks have had to rapidly adapt to their recently deforested home.

name: Cave Kroling
desc: Like many species of Krolusk, this variety seems to prefer the isles network of underground caves.

name: Doomfeathers
desc: It glides through the air with shadowy wings and a trail of eerie whispers.

name: Faithful Dog
desc: No longer lost or lonely, your faithful companion has decided that by your side is the best place to be.

name: Wobbles
desc: Incredibly lifelike, this enchanted wax statue could pass for a real mole. If petting it didn't cause it to melt, that is.

name: Coppers
desc: One hero's trash is another kobold's treasure. This unfortunately does not work in reverse.

name: Pillaged Parrot
desc: This beautiful macaw is awfully far from home, and seeks the company of a more worthy companion than it's previous 'owners'.

name: Snapdragon Pup
desc: It is said that the bite of a snapdragon pup is many times stronger and more potent than the adults.

name: Ada the Sweetest
desc: PH - Tech was made to allow customizations.

name: Foreman
desc: Eagerly attends every cookout. He just wants to grill for gob's sake!

name: Eepy
desc: He's just a bit tuckered out. He's just a little guy.

name: Scruff
desc: Gotta be tough with the scruff.

name: Emerald Hatchling
desc: After getting lost in the thick of battle, this hawkstrider chick needs a new home.

name: Goggles
desc: Do the hyenas need to wear goggles? Absolutely not. Does it look extremely cool? Incredibly.
