name: Spotty
desc: People get turned into rats sometimes. It's not that weird.

name: Ixthal the Observling
desc: Ixthal enjoys hide-and-seek when not contemplating the slow devouring of entire worlds by the Void.

name: Mutt
desc: One more thing... Show my hound some respect.

name: Wavebreaker Mechasaur
desc: And then, woosh! It comes stampeding out of the ocean and like, roars! Raaargh!

name: Crimson Mechasaur
desc: It's red because it like, killed so many bad guys! It's all their blood! And it's on fire too!

name: Viridian Mechasaur
desc: It totally fell into a pit of acid but then it came back ten times stronger! So cool!!!

name: Fun-Size Flarendo
desc: Nuh-uh! Yellow is coolest! It's themed after the original, who's totally gonna beat that stupid gorilla!

name: Frumpy Softpaw
desc: These grumpy, frumpy meeksi only seem to find joy when drinking a boba milk tea with salted caramel and cookie dough.

name: Rocketfist
desc: And even if they reach the danish, they'll never get past Rocketfist!

name: Mega-Mecha Gorilla
desc: Mega-Mecha Gorilla possesses the strength of not one, but FIVE gorillas.

name: Tiny Torq
desc: Tiny Torq's dad could TOTALLY beat up Flarendo's dad.

name: Professor Punch
desc: And he was all like, Primal Punch!!

name: Bilgewater Junkhauler
desc: Scrap metal hunks hauling junk.

name: Kal'andu
desc: Rescued from the Druids of the Flame's onslaught upon the Emerald Dream, this juvenile faerie dragon has taken a liking to you -- and to your food. Don't leave your snacks unattended!

name: Seedle
desc: Seedles burrow beneath plants in the emerald dreams and nibble at their roots.

name: Personal-Use Sapper
desc: Fun for the whole family! A self-detonating robot for all occasions!

name: Mr. DELVER
desc: Originally built by Dr. DELVER to compete with renowned treasure hunter Brann Bronzebeard. Never really panned out though, so now he just helps out.

name: Steamwheedle Flunkie
desc: It's lame to have a hunchbacked crony mewl 'yes master' when you can just get a robot to do it for free.

name: Blackwater Kegmover
desc: Being a pirate is alright with me, especially if you've got this thing willing to carry your grog.

name: Venture Companyman
desc: Yes boss! Yes boss! Yes boss!

name: Dustite
desc: Dustites scavenge among the roots of great trees for any small leavings they can find.

name: Somnolet
desc: Dream on. Dream until your dream comes true!

name: Kabluey
desc: Ten thousand years spent floating in a time stasis is quite a bit of time to work on material.

name: Wily Rat
desc: The thicker and more gangly the whiskers, the more devious the rodent. That's just basic biology.

name: Acid-Drenched Rat
desc: Stop me if you've heard this one before: they fell into a vat of radioactive acid.

name: Lab Rat
desc: They weren't lying, this rat can absolutely get that dang cheese.

name: Squally
desc: Though this little one's flight training has yet to be completed, their playfulness and enthusiasm are already fully grown.

name: Buggsy
desc: Farmers will often release maidenbugs to battle the pests that threaten their crops. Buggsy was so good at this that she decided to go pro.

name: Underroach
desc: Scientists, engineers, and gamers of Undermine must keep their desks clean lest they be visited by the underroaches.

name: Bombshell Crab
desc: The natural habitat of these crabs is so polluted and devoid of shells that they've been forced to take shelter in discarded goblin munitions. Are you gonna keep littering after learning that?

name: Venture Bombshell
desc: In a pinch, Venture Co. workers might use these creatures for some impromptu demolition. Get it? Pinch?

name: Cave Crab
desc: Buried amid sand and sediment, these crabs blend right into their environment.

name: Kaja Crab
desc: Did it spend too long near kaja'mite? Did someone give it kaja'cola? Who knows, but the name is great branding.

name: Mechagopher
desc: Do you see pity in these blinking, soulless eyes? I didn't think so.

name: Varmint MK II
desc: Before the Mark II, Varmints were a sorry excuse for an annoying and over-engineered pest. Now, though? They're absolutely infuriating!

name: Lime Roboclucker
desc: The acid-green accents add a sporty vibe to this flightless robotic bird thing.

name: Gill'el
desc: Gill'el stepped down from leading Frostfin clan to commune with the elements. His return has sparked excitement in all.

name: Iron Chick
desc: Shrugs off boiling oil and eleven secret herbs and spices. Just don't introduce it to rust.

name: Tropical Frog
desc: A recent excavation on Zuldazar obliterated the natural habitat of these creatures and sent them spilling into the wilds.

name: Spring-Loaded Ribbitron
desc: A robotic frog might seem useless, but once you're attacked by a swarm of mechanical flies, you'll be wishing you had one.

name: Ultrahopper EX
desc: Faster. Stronger. And it can double jump.

name: Bluedoo
desc: Bluedoo's magic and skills in accupuncture will help any in need of relaxation.

name: Reven
desc: The game's afoot. Except when it is time to nap. Afterwards though, it's game on!

name: Grunch
desc: It's best not to ask how Grunch acquired all these gifts because you know it's not because he's been nice.

name: Gizmo the Pure
desc: In life, Gizmo never hurt a soul. Having been brutally murdered, he now considers violence.

name: Pascal the Wonder Pup
desc: PH - Tech was made to allow customizations.

name: Tobias
desc: With a nose for secrets, Tobias is ready to be by the side of super sleuths.

name: Portentous Present
desc: Previous owners of the crate have reported the disappearance of other pets from their collection.

name: Cliffreach Cub
desc: These small cubs are as fiesty as they are cuddly.

name: Lil' Maggz
desc: As heir to the Lord of Outland, Maggz has always shared his family's love of violence and power. He just happens to be even more in love with pet treats.

name: Reverie
desc: The duck of your dreams... or perhaps someone else's dreams.

name: Blueloo
desc: If you ever have an outdoor feast in the Emerald Dream, look out for wild blueloos. A blueloo won't steal your picinic basket, but it will politely ask for some snacks.

name: Chillbot 9000
desc:
RELAXATION MODE: ENGAGED.
RELAXATION LEVEL: MAXIMUM.
INTERNAL TEMPERATURE: LOW.

name: Sparklesnap
desc: Reaching for what you thought was a pile of plunder turned out to be Sparklesnap's treasure-laden shell. After mistakenly petting his back, he now eagerly follows you.

name: N'Ruby
desc: A lifetime of servitude to Anub'arak, then the Lich King, and now... you!

name: Slim
desc: One kobyss's meal is another adventurer's bestie.

name: Sir Shady Mrrgglton Junior
desc: The shadowy creature has been following Sir Finley Mrrgglton around ever since he happened upon it during one of his expeditions. Having grown quite fond of the tenebrous friend, Sir Finley won't part with it easily.

name: Umbral Amalgam
desc: These swarms of void energy cannot persist in Beledar's light.

name: Pokee
desc: The needle in Pokee's eye isn't exactly comfortable fashion, but he's stuck with it.

name: Alchemical Runoff
desc: Lab leaks are sometimes dangerous. Sometimes, they're cute. Sometimes, both!

name: Parley
desc: Parley is a rather serious and grumpy bird. If you value your eyeballs, it's best not to ask if Parley wants a cracker.

name: Clay Stonecharger
desc: The swooping horns of protorams bear the scars of every charge.

name: Sandstone Ramolith
desc: They loves sand. It's coarse, and it gets everywhere.

name: Tidbit
desc: Most felstalkers are fiercesome and ravenous. This one, however, seems to be feeling a bit lonely.

name: Morsel
desc: Known to take a bite out of his owner. Pet cautiously.

name: Newsy
desc: Newsy delivers mail all around the Dragon Isles. She is so quick and reliable that the small holes on the letters she delivers are negligible.

name: Drowsey
desc: Is it a snail? Is it a dream? Is it the dream of a sleeping snail?

name: Storm-Infused Snapdragon
desc: Snapdragon pups that were abandoned on the shores have become infused with the energies of the Seafury Tempest, as the other Siren Isle creatures have.

name: Pale Hexscale
desc: Its bite carries more than venom.

name: Scavenging Snapdragon
desc: It is said that from the moment they hatch snapdragons are independent from their parents, though the more recent venture to Nazjatar has seemingly debunked this theory.

name: Snorr
desc: Wyvern whelps are sleepy by nature. The dreams of wyvern whelps are doubly so.

name: Crackleroar
desc: This small cub has been influenced by constant storms on Siren Isle. Just petting it's soft fur sends static shocks across your hand.

name: Skitterbite
desc: This krolusk seems to display an unusual level of intellegence in it's shiny red, reflective eyes.

name: Parrlok
desc: Ancient Gorian blood runs through Parrlok's veins. As far as anyone knows, his desire for enjoying pastries and chatting with his friends keeps his imperial ambitions in check.

name: Gummi
desc: Gummi baubleworms have an abundance of natural predators, as they are known for their rubbery texture and sweet flavors.

name: Rusziona
desc: Rusziona's newfound courage means she can accompany you on adventures! Nothing in all of Azeroth can stop her! Not even a duck!

name: Mitzy
desc: When she grows up, Mitzy wants to guide Greatfather Winter's sleigh just like Metzen, her famous dad. Until then, she's more than happy to come with you on your adventures.

name: Lil' Flameo
desc: Lil' Flameo is ready to drop foolish pets if they get in the way.

name: Niblet
desc: Glows green, occassionally.

name: Flooftalon
desc: The first thing you might notice about this creature is its huge expressive eyes. This is a mistake. Instead focus on its razor-sharp claws.

name: Fol'ya Pup
desc: Keep it out of your backpack or it will eat all your food and then take a nap.

name: Sapnibbler
desc: Sapnibblers are always up for a game of hide and squeak.

name: Gale
desc: A Stormrider's stormrook can not only navigate extreme winds with grace but can also conjure fierce tempests to defend themselves.

name: Flash
desc: Emberrooks are the rarest and most aggressive of the rook elementals.

name: Thundo
desc: A full-sized stormrook's thunder can be heard for miles. The chirps of this small spark sound like a faulty electrical device.

name: Ruby-Eyed Stagshell
desc: Stagshells crave violence. Or at least simulated representations of violence.

name: Rak-Ush Battleshell
desc: Raised as living tanks for Anub'azal's army, Rak-Ush's battleshells are surprisingly affectionate. Who's a good beetle?

name: Leyhart
desc: This little one likes cheese, but most fawn do.

name: Slumbertooth
desc: As younglings, these critters need a lot of naps. Fortunately, adventurers' backpacks make good napping spots.

name: Pewling
desc: If you think the skunks of the Emerald Dream smell bad, pray that you never smell the skunks of the Emerald Nightmare.

name: Hoplet
desc: Because it's her favorite holiday, Hoplet wears her Lunar Festival outfit year-ound.

name: Thrillbot 9000
desc:
PRIMARY DIRECTIVE: ENGAGE IN HEROICS.
PREFERRED HEROICS: THRILLING.
SECONDARY DIRECTIVE: BECOME HERO.
PREFERRED HERO: BIG.

name: Sergeant Quackers
desc: When enemy combatants fly overhead, there's only one thing to do. Duck.

name: Aura
desc: At a young age Aura donned her magic hat, took her crystal staff, and set off for adventure into the unknown.

name: Baa'lial
desc: Also known as the Lord of Lies, Baa'lial is a master of deceit.

name: Mote of Nasz'uro
desc: The light of the new legacy illuminates the path you forge.

name: Lovely Duckling
desc: Of all the shades and colors of ducklings that come forth in the spring, the most prized are the pink ones. There are many theories about why, but it's likely just because pink is awesome.

name: Beetriz
desc: Yellow maidenbugs are often mistaken for other yellow insects. This happens even more often to Beetriz, and she doesn't understand why.

name: Reese
desc: Even Nirobin, a self-proclaimed genius of the highest caliber, could not deny the cuteness of his arcane creation.

name: Hap'he
desc: It is bewildering how the most arrogant and stuck up of the Azerothian Archivists can't help but create the most adorable arcane familiars. Perhaps Nirobin does have a soft side...

name: Pale Slumbertooth
desc: These creatures live in bushes and near trees, but they sleep so soundly they're practically invisible. If you want to interrupt their dreaming, you'd best bring friends.

name: Ebon Ploughworm
desc: Hard to spot in the dark, these worms have taught many adventureres a lesson, when sticking their fingers where they don't belong.

name: Common Ploughworm
desc: Used both in battle and as pack animals when they're larger, at this size they're only a danger to your ankles.

name: Lil' Bonechewer
desc: Lil' Bonechewer loves you, even if you were a worm. Especially if you were a worm.

name: Venom Elemental
desc: As potent as he is dimunitive.

name: Violet Sporbit
desc: Dangerous, toxic spores? What if it was purple?!

name: Specter
desc: Found by Taunka as a newborn pup Specter is fiercely loyal. Yet he is beginning to live up to his name as he stalks into the world.

name: Karazhan Syphoner
desc: Rarely captured alive, syphoners are some of the most dangerous of the mana wyrms. This one happened to have been distracted while binging on a particularly juicy spell book in the Karazhan library.

name: Teele
desc: Teele's grandparents told him they were the mice that discovered Azeroth. They were also champion fibbers.

name: Hemospore
desc: Fungal spores awash in the blood of fallen monstrosities.

name: Emerald Sporbit
desc: This collection of spores exploded one too many times on its previous owner. Maybe you'll have better luck with it.

name: Briarhorn Hatchling
desc: Loves: Broccoli, playing, and smashing things. Hates: Meat, sleeping, and mean titan keepers who won't let you smash things.

name: Gill'dan
desc: Gill'dan earned his great power by drinking the blood of a demon, which would also have turned his scales green had they not already been that color.

name: Wind-Up Wuffi
desc: With a face this lovable Wuffi is sure you'll wind-up being the best of friends.

name: Wind-Up Woofer
desc: A wag of their tail always brings a smile to your face, like clockwork.

name: Sa'bak's Blessed
desc: According to Tol'vir beliefs, a crocolisk nest that hatches during the Festival of the Sun is said to be blessed by the river guardian, Sa'bak.

name: Snaggletoof
desc: Such toof. Such snaggle.

name: Glamrok
desc: Glamrok followed you back to the ship one day after a particularly good plunder, sensing your keen knack for treasure-finding.

name: Bubbles
desc: Where do all of the bubbles come from? What are they made of? Perhaps some mysteries are best left unexplored.

name: Jeepers
desc: This eye has witnessed untold horrors, and these fangs may be responsible for a few of their own.

name: Doomrubble
desc: He seems to be very angry, but it's possible he's just hungry.

name: Slyvy
desc: These astral phenomena are rarely sighted due to the speed of the slyvern. It is a good omen to have one following you around.

name: Nelle
desc: Though fully-grown maidenbugs are able to fly, Nelle is just a bit too young for that. She's happy to skitter alongside you all the same.

name: Spicy Mean-Ball
desc: Now this is one, spicy, mean, ball.

name: Subterranean Dartswog
desc: Found predominately underground, some of them prefer the surface. But that's none of my business.

name: Troglofrog
desc: The sound of the troglofrog echoing throughout deep caverns sounds almost like... ragtime music?

name: Dalaran Sewer Turtle
desc: More than a typical turtle, he's a hero in a half shell!

name: Mind Slurp
desc: One shudders to imagine whether the name was based off of what it is... or what it does.

name: Killbot 9000
desc: DEFECTIVE; REFUSES TO KILL. MARK FOR IMMEDIATE DESTRUCTION OR SALE TO LESS INTELLIGENT ENTITY.

name: Obsidian Warwhelp
desc: A war-obsessed world turned her into a weapon... but they couldn't break her spirit.

name: Sao'rhon
desc: A very friendly cosmic being. Direct eye contact will obliterate your soul.

name: Inquisitive Cosmic Ray Pup
desc: This cosmic ray pup is curious about a great many things. Don't let it get into trouble (again)!

name: Mr. Long-Legs
desc: A favorite pet of some poor soul from before the fall of K'aresh, found trapped in stasis.

name: Mustyfur Fel Snooter
desc: An especially aggressive snooter. Its unpleasant disposition makes it an outcast among other snooters.

name: Heka'Tarnos, Bringer of Discord
desc: This exceptionally loud lapbug's calls were enough to throw the already destabilized elements in the local area into complete disarray. Now it's your turn to get bugged.

name: Dragonhawk Mosswing
desc: These dragonhawks developed in the wilds of Zul'aman, where their green feathers and molt help them hide from hunters and predators.

name: Pangolil
desc: He's scheming. Smirking. Don't trust him.

name: Gloom Toad
desc: Have a hoppy day!

name: Scruffyhorn Fel Snooter
desc: Of all snooters, this one has the scruffiest and warmest fur. It is a very friendly snooter but use extreme caution when petting it.

name: Zo'ya
desc: Zo'ya is cunning and beautiful, both highly desirable traits among purrkins. Despite being the culprit behind many mishaps, her warm glow ensures she is forgiven for any transgression.

name: Dundun
desc: [PH]

name: Silkcrawler
desc: Totally gonna transform into a beautiful winged creature, yup. It just might take a few dozen years.

name: Nether Familiar
desc: Arcane-infused wyrms are favored familiars of Eversong mages.

name: Vibrant Manaling
desc: The mana wyrm population really picked up after the Arcane Torrent nerf.

name: Wrathful Wyrm
desc: It's popping wings! Run!

name: Riftblade Familiar
desc: Rumored to be the familiar of a ren'dorei mage that escaped to the wilds of Voidstorm and became even more void infused.

name: Flotsam Harvester
desc: These tiny harvesters are often deployed along the coastline during low tide to collect cargo and timbers that have washed ashore from shipwrecks.

name: Unfazed Diver
desc: While purrkin have a knack for getting lost, none have ever been so talented as this one. Purrfectly unbothered however, this curious creature can thrive in any situation.

name: Festive Eve
desc: Winter festivities seem to follow Eve wherever she goes.

name: Bundled-Up Bob
desc: Once native to the northern regions of the Eastern Kingdoms, this species of seal is now only common in Northrend after being hunted for food and leather during the Second War.

name: Emerrrgl
desc: The emerald sheen of this murloc is likely formed from constant grooming and a robust exercise routine.

name: Lil' Chompers
desc: If you have a fish odds are Lil' Chompers will be nearby.

name: Fledgling Warden's Companion
desc: This young fledgeling is ready and eager to begin training.

name: Auspicious Pixiu
desc: A rare auspicious beast in Pandaria. Well-traveled hozen call it a "mobile luck amplifier."

name: Starshard Whelpling
desc: Curious and inquisitive, this starry-eyed whelpling has big dreams and a wish to explore every world in the cosmos.

name: Shadefur Brewthief
desc: If you have milk tea, keep an eye on it. Brewthieves love to pop out of the shadows and steal tea. Even worse, once in paw they love to show off their newly acquired beverage.

name: Slippery Saul
desc: Slippery Saul loves to slide around the ground or the sea looking for fish.

name: Lil' Coalee
desc: No one knows how Lil' Coalee got his name. Was it his black heart? Was it his love for a warm fire? Was it simply that one of his parents were Big Coalee. Asking him yields no answers, only rage.

name: Do, Child of Filo
desc: Like his father, Do speaks little but is a friend to almost everyone except those who harm innocents.

name: Smoldering Valor
desc: With boundless energy and unbridled enthusiasm, the foal seeks the skies. It may not be ready, but exercise caution if you try to hold it back.

name: Fishmonger May
desc: You can never have too many fish according to May.

name: Rustyroot Fel Snooter
desc: Fel Snooters have a very good sense of smell. They will often immolate piles of leaves, scrap or snow to find grass and seeds.

name: Copper Lapbug
desc: Lapbugs were widely prized as domesticated pets before the fall of K'aresh. Copper lapbugs were especially sought-after.

name: Cerulean Lapbug
desc: Widely prized as pets, cerulean lapbugs were thought to bring good fortune.

name: Fishstick Keith
desc: Frozen fish are Keith's favorite treat. If you've got frozen fish, you've got a new best friend.

name: Duskytooth Fel Snooter
desc: The dark, fel-infused fur of the duskytooth allows them to more easily hide in the forests of Felwood.

name: Veridian Thorntail
desc: This baby thorntail's favorite activity is splashing in small puddles.

name: Scrappy Thorntail
desc: This little thorntail just loves to get into scraps and scrapes with its greatest foe: lapbugs.

name: Hawkstrider Hatchling
desc: When does a hatchling become a fledgling if hawkstriders never fledge?

name: Tiny Snow Buddy
desc: So much holiday spirit inside an itty-bitty amount of snow, it only makes sense to share it with the world!

name: Lil' Daz'ti
desc: Ancient dinomancers once believed that pure white scales on dinosaurs indicated the influence of celestial bodies.  In their pursuit of balance, the Lun'alai have embraced these superstitions in their efforts to restore the white brutosaur.

name: Heartglow Listener
desc: Kindness gives hope golden wings, and the Heartglow Listener's feathers are with us through every tranquil night.

name: Dread Horrorling
desc: Early attempts to integrate with the ecosystem resulted in multiple specimens being eyeblasted.

name: Impartial Watcher
desc: This watcher's ennui is as eternal as the struggle between the Light and the Void.

name: Penumbral Terror
desc: It waits and watches from the shadows. Softly. Softly.

name: Rhay'Dahr
desc: Ever watchful, never blinking.

name: Naloki
desc: With war paint on her fur and a growl in her belly, Naloki dreams of one day roaring like Nalorakk.

name: Scruffbeak
desc: Hatched from a long-forgotten egg, this scruffy little eagle has decided you're its new flock, whether you're ready or not.

name: Akil Fledgling
desc: The molted feathers of these young eagles are used to build comfortable bedding for the Amani.

name: Rootling Nester
desc: Young grovecrawlers are known to curl up around the ankles of its protectors for rest.

name: Mud Potadpole
desc: They do NOT taste like potatoes. Promise.

name: Violet Chick
desc: These prissy, flightless birds are known to relentlessly groom themselves. Much like their riders.

name: Looker Gaz'kreth Jr.
desc: While not viewed as insightful enough to be a Watcher just yet, he's on the lookout for others to share his vision with.

name: Xanthous Siphonmite
desc: Siphonmites generally feed on the energies of dying worlds, but this one is perfectly content with getting some scritches from researchers instead.

name: Jimmy
desc: Jimmy's actual name is Morgilito, Spawn of Morgil, Chosen Enemy of Tazavesh, Devourer of K'aresh...but everyone just calls him Jimmy.

name: Ebon Snapling
desc: Oh snap!! Lizard!

name: Blistercreepling
desc: You'd think with all those spikes, it might pop its own pustule sac. But no! Its pustule sac is actually really sturdy! Pustule sac!

name: Swamp Biter
desc: Lurking beneath dark waters with needle sharp teeth. You can bite and drink their blood too, though. It's allowed.

name: Nether Siphoner
desc: A gnashing maw of teeth and tongues. This beast bears an uncanny resemblance to Azerothian leeches.

name: Azure Sporebat
desc: Distinct from the sporebats that reside on Draenor and Outland. It's just a coincidence.

name: Cyan Siphonmite
desc: How this siphonmite snuck its way into a stasis container is anyone's guess.

name: Vitriolic Inchshifter
desc: Who knew these things could eat so much?

name: Palek'ti, the Mouth of Nothingness
desc: Still not quite old enough to leave the nest.

name: Shimmering Inchshifter
desc: Projections showed a less than one percent chance of successful integration, but this one is too cute to eliminate.

name: Graceful Cosmic Ray Pup
desc: Efforts to rewire the more desctructive tendencies of the species left this specimen more docile than most, but it was still not a successful endeavor.

name: Starlight
desc: Seeks out the light of the stars. Even in the daytime.

name: Duskthief
desc: Drawn to shiny objects. And darkness. Especially darkness.

name: Chubs
desc: Separated from his mother when they were captured. Chubs is sad but fierce. He takes pride when he can bite his Twilight Blade handlers hands at feeding time.

name: Lil' Preyseeker
desc: This wyrm can't wait to grow up big and strong so it can hunt Prey too!

name: Overloaded Manaling
desc: The naga's mix of arcane and void magics have disturbed the mana wyrms around Daggerspine Point making them extremely hostile. The very few manalings remaining in the aftermath of their ritual are showing unique abilities.

name: Void-Corrupted Snapdragon
desc: The loyal snapdragon are the perfect companion to any naga. They adapt well to their environment especially when the environment likes to adapt them.

name: Void-Touched Chick
desc: Ravaged by the invading naga, many hawkstriders died in the area of Daggerspine Point. It is rare to find any of their young yet alive.

name: Classic Clockwork Quacker
desc: Quack. Beep. Beep. Quack.

name: Aquatic Clockwork Quacker
desc: Beep. Beep. Quack. Quack.

name: Void-Touched Lynx Kitten
desc: This curious kitten has been hanging around one too many ritual sites.

name: Kirin Tor Kitty
desc: Don't be put off by this cat's icy demeanor.

name: Archmage's Familiar
desc: Knocks potions and reagents off shelves for "research purposes."

name: Lil'Kruul
desc: When you weren't looking, Murkidan killed Lil'Kruul. He's back now, though.

name: Furiostraza
desc: She's perfect! Unlike the genetic absurdities you call twilight whelpings!

name: Poisoned Parasite
desc: They suck. That's it.

name: Munchy
desc: A young grovecrawler that has been lovingly cared for by the Hara'ti.

name: Moon Darter
desc: Since Amirdrassil's emergence, many faerie dragons have taken refuge in Belameth. But many others continue to call Kalimdor home.

name: Sha-Warped Hippogryph Hatchling
desc: Sha has warped this hippogryph hatchling into an adorable but fearsome creature. The big emotions that flow through this creature make it an adorable harbinger of doom.

name: Void-Scarred Eaglet
desc: The eagles of Zul'Aman are a regal species yet they have suffered without Akil'zon watching over them. Faithbreaker Ger'lok has been especially cruel testing his dark magic on the young eaglets.

name: Sporbie
desc: "In this house we don't lay spores in people's ears when they sleep, no matter how funny their face is when they wake up."

name: Ziorg'pharon
desc: Ziorg'pharon, Emissary of the Cosmic Unknown, Ender of All That Is, Was, and Will Ever Be, or Zigy, as his friends call him, is physically incapable of harming a fly.

name: Kreepah'zoyd
desc: It doesn't bite. It rips and tears.

name: Spormilian
desc: Waddles around in a constant cloud of spores. Harmless? Hard to say--we're still waiting on the research team... or what's left of them.

name: Lost Star
desc: Nothing is known for certain, though some believe it calls the night sky its home.

name: Ominous Domanus
desc: Truly evil, undeniably powerful... but above all, spectacularly lazy.

name: Hexed Bunny
desc: In the wrong place at the wrong time.

name: Treja'saka
desc: A curious species found only within treasure chests. Harmless enough, unless you happen to be wearing jewelry.

name: Nibblesworth
desc: Very unhappy. Always goes for the jugular. Kind of cute.

name: Percival
desc: This potadpole is constantly getting stuck in things.

name: Skipper
desc: Skipper loves water and magic. Watch out if you get her angry!

name: Emberlyn
desc: Kindled in a ritual of flame and feather, she grows with a restless heat, drawn to the softest morsels and the sharpest scents, her tiny wings carrying both comfort and cinders wherever she flits.

name: Emberwing Hatchling
desc: Born near the funeral pyre in Solemn Valley, this young eagle's burgundy feathers still carry the scent of smoke and ash. A quiet reminder that even in loss, something new can take wing.

name: Lil' Ashlee
desc: Lil' Ashlee quietly bides her time waiting for a power vacuum. Once in power Lil' Ashlee will bring fun, merriment and fire to all!

name: Akiki
desc: This eagle was a favored companion of Kinduru's during his travels through Zul'Aman.

name: Gortham
desc: A living anomaly and Kasreth's most treasured experiment, this pink-furred creature scampers joyfully through conduits and pipes.

name: Dragonhawk Munchkin
desc: This tiny breed of dragonhawk is popular for those who prefer to keep their companions travel sized. Just keep them away from curtains.

name: Flicker
desc: A rare black-furred Eversong lynx kitten, its fur faintly thrumming with arcane energy, bred by Silvermoon's Magisters as both companion and conduit of magical study.

name: Sunwing Hatchling
desc: Born and raised in Sunwing Rookery, this fella loves causing mischief when the tamers aren't looking.

name: Zan
desc: This young snake was hatched from a purified egg of Ula'tek. His sister, Zarra, befriended a lonely beast stranded on Atal'Utek. However, he bonded to you and will be your fierce friend forever.

name: Shadowflame Remnant
desc: A lingering remnant of Fyrakk's attempt at corrupting Amirdrassil.

name: Roofus
desc: Roofus is ready to lend a paw for any construction project. Treats aren't required, but are appreciated.

name: Silvermoon Broom
desc: Magisters love to turn on their enchanted brooms before heading off to work, only to find it stuck in a corner of their Silvermoon apartment.

name: Grumpy Mandrake
desc: Warning: It may root against you.

name: Sleepy Mandrake
desc: Nestled in his cozy cave, this little mandrake sprout was one of the last. Over time though his favorite mushrooms stopped growing in his cave. So he decided to sleep... waiting for his favorite spores to blow in again.

name: Nova
desc: He is a lover, not a battler.

name: Ka'bubb
desc: A true Abyss Angler, certified by Depthdiver Jeju himself.

name: P.O.S.T. Assistant
desc: While the markets of Tazavesh are a well-oiled machine, the P.O.S.T. service is a whirlwind of parchment, cartons, and rambunctious livestock. The use of P.O.S.T. assistants to handle dangerous material has saved a great many headaches.

name: Bubbly Snapling
desc: What a happy snapling!

name: Rescued Dragonhawk Chick
desc: The exposure to void energy was minimal, however it is already showing signs of new void abilities. Its abilities can be managed with the right training. - Sergeant Vornin

name: Void-Infused Mindbreaker Fry
desc: The mindbreakers are a rare creature of the deep. Little is known of their true origins but they link back to the days of the Black Empire.

name: Cursed Spawn
desc: The Curse of Ula'tek manifests serpents of all varieties. Including ones that are tiny and vaguely cute!

name: Jaundiced Slitherer
desc: These snakes dredge themselves out of the venom to live miserable existences. Also, do you mind if they crash at your place for a weekend?

name: Caustic Writhling
desc: There's Children of Ula'tek, and then there's the BABY of Ula'tek!

name: Nightfur Kapara
desc: It's said that the capybara has no enemies, but the Children of Ula'tek didn't get that memo.

name: Sleek Snakebiter
desc: The snakebiters of Atal'Utek have had their hands full as of late. They're bigs fans of your recent arrival.

name: Silento
desc: Unlike most Voidwalkers in the Voidstorm, Silento prefers the peace and quiet of silence. Even if that means silencing the more chatty of his kin.

name: Star the Lucky Dragon
desc: Star just hatched and is ready for adventure. Sometimes napping is the greatest adventure of all.

name: Gummi the Glow Wyrm
desc: Gummi the Glow Wyrm has an abundance of natural predators, as it is known for their rubbery texture and sweet flavors.

name: Distorted Memory
desc: A roiling memory drawn to you from the Rift of Aln.

name: Luma
desc: Luma knows all kinds of tricks such as "sit," "stay," and "steal."

name: Steady Croakfrog
desc: Really, really good at staring contests.

name: Autumn Snapling
desc: Adapted to survive in the autumnal hues of Zul'Aman foliage.

name: The Sire's Ghastly Screecher
desc: A rare mutation gives this dredbat its green, ghastly glow making it a sought after gift for pet collectors with eclectic tastes.

name: Catsramas
desc: Sometimes a good cat nap is all you need to stave of death.

name: Linda the Lucky
desc: This potadpole is grateful for your assistance after having been exposed to the Lightboom.

name: Sunflicker Driftmoth
desc: Lazy as a mote of dust in a sunbeam, this moth drifts with the breeze as if in no particular hurry to be anywhere.

name: Vibrant Venomfang
desc: Ula'tek's venom gave rise to new color variants of wind serpents, like this little pink one.

name: Cat'Thuzad
desc: Do not let this cat cross your path.

name: Mewkahen
desc: When a cat has been raised among the Tol'vir can you blame themd being a bit aloof?

name: Lil' Staropod
desc: Stars walk among us in the shape of a baby brutosaur.

name: Blitzcreek
desc: Evolving in the Voidstorm has really made its smaller inhabitants significantly more aggressive.

name: Fidoficus
desc: While it didn't make a good test subject, perhaps it will make a good companion.

name: Voldy
desc: Sometimes the void's call is faint, so smaller, younger voidwalkers heed its call.

name: Kai
desc: Formed by the latent energies from the Singularity Anchor this Behemoth will be loyal till the end.

name: Amewbisath
desc: Amewbisath is a meance to the smallest of qiraji.

name: Princess Bloodshed
desc: Taking after her mother, Dame Bloodshed, the Princess is armed with the sharpest of claws and the furriest of ears.

name: Dali
desc: Dali, bored of his days basking in the comfort of the Solaarian Sunbath, seeks a world of new inspiration. You are that inspiration, and he will bring color to your world.

name: Wriggling Capybara
desc: At home in small dens, these little guys wriggle into all sorts of tight spots, even sometimes supply pouches.

name: Cappy
desc: Having the bad luck to face many void corruption hostilities, Cappy has persevered. He is one of the few creatures to make it through mostly unscathed.

name: Willie
desc: This bold elfhound was born to chase mana wyrms, and mana wyrm-shaped objects... Like unattended sausages.

name: Curious Lynx Kitten
desc: The saying curiosity killed the cat wasn't written about the Eversong lynx, even if their reckless kittens do find their way to the frontlines. A few rangers have found a lifelong companion stowed away in the supply wagons on campaign.

name: Assistant Botanist Leafy
desc: Assistant Botanist Leafy is an expert at identifying edible plants... which is all of them.

name: Perturbed Sporebat
desc: After being rudely stuffed into a gourd in a vain effort to treat a Lightbloom infestation, this sporebat's just grateful to be out.

name: Medusa
desc: She hates head pats, hence the spiky armor.

name: Razeshi C.
desc: Razeshi C. is known for her understanding tempermant, measured responses and a love for gossip. The C. stands for "Class act."

name: J'imothy
desc: Got into a spot of trouble digging through magical garbage in Silvermoon. Luckily, you were there to help him out!
